const encoder = new TextEncoder();
function emit(label, value) {
  if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("emit: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

  const text = JSON.stringify([label, value]);
  const bytes = encoder.encode(text);
  if (bytes.length > 1048576) throw new Error("inspector output exceeds 1MiB");

  return console.log(text);
}
function ensure(ok, message) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof message !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'message' expected string, got " + typeof message);

  if (!ok) throw new Error(message);

}
function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}
function appendItem(values, item) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new TypeError("appendItem: arg 'values' expected array, got " + typeof values);

  return [...values, item];
}
function inspect(value, seen, depth) {
  if (typeof seen !== "object" || seen === null) throw new TypeError("inspect: arg 'seen' expected object, got " + typeof seen);

  if (typeof depth !== "number" || Number.isNaN(depth)) throw new TypeError("inspect: arg 'depth' expected number, got " + typeof depth);

  seen.set("visits", seen.get("visits") + 1);
  if (seen.get("visits") > 4096) return { kind: "visit-bound" };

  if (depth > 256) return { kind: "depth-bound" };

  if (value === null) return { kind: "null" };

  const kind = typeof value;
  if (kind === "number") return { kind: kind, value: Object.is(value, Number("-0")) ? "-0" : String(value), finite: Number.isFinite(value) };

  if (kind === "string") return { kind: kind, value: value.slice(0, 4096), length: value.length, truncated: value.length > 4096 };

  if (!(kind === "object")) return { kind: kind, value: String(value) };

  if (seen.has(value)) return { kind: "reference", id: seen.get(value) };

  if (seen.size >= 2048) return { kind: "node-bound" };

  const id = seen.size;
  seen.set(value, id);
  const tag = Object.prototype.toString.call(value);
  if (tag === "[object Date]") return { kind: "date", id: id, milliseconds: String(value.getTime()), iso: Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value.toISOString() };

  if (tag === "[object RegExp]") return { kind: "regexp", id: id, source: value.source, flags: value.flags };

  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return { kind: tag, id: id, byteLength: value.byteLength, hex: hex(new Uint8Array(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, Math.min(value.byteLength, 4096))), truncated: value.byteLength > 4096 };

  if (tag === "[object Map]") return { kind: "map", id: id, entries: Array.from(value).slice(0, 2048).map(pair => {
    if (!Array.isArray(pair)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'pair' expected array, got " + typeof pair);

    return [inspect(pair[0], seen, depth + 1), inspect(pair[1], seen, depth + 1)];
  }), size: value.size, truncated: value.size > 2048 };

  if (tag === "[object Set]") return { kind: "set", id: id, values: Array.from(value).slice(0, 2048).map(v => inspect(v, seen, depth + 1)), size: value.size, truncated: value.size > 2048 };

  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  return { kind: Array.isArray(value) ? "array" : "object", tag: tag, id: id, length: Array.isArray(value) ? value.length : null, truncated: keys.length > 2048, entries: keys.slice(0, 2048).map(key => {
    if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

    return [{ kind: "string", value: key }, inspect(value[key], seen, depth + 1)];
  }) };
}
function tree(value) {
  return inspect(value, new Map([["visits", 0]]), 0);
}
function errorFact(stage, err) {
  if (typeof stage !== "string") throw new TypeError("errorFact: arg 'stage' expected string, got " + typeof stage);

  return emit("error", { stage: stage, name: err.name, message: err.message, details: tree(err) });
}
function materialize(data) {
  if (typeof data !== "string") throw new TypeError("materialize: arg 'data' expected string, got " + typeof data);

  for (const item of JSON.parse(data)) {
    Deno.writeFileSync(item.path, unhex(item.hex));
  }
}
const allowed = new Set(["Y-01-edit", "Y-02-true-plain-default", "Y-02-true-plain-core", "Y-02-true-plain-failsafe", "Y-02-true-quoted-default", "Y-02-true-quoted-core", "Y-02-true-quoted-failsafe", "Y-04-duplicate-reject", "Y-05-alias", "Y-06-cycle", "Y-06-unresolved", "Y-08-two-parse", "Y-08-two-parseAll", "Y-09-malformed", "Y-10-noop", "Y-10-edit"]);
async function probe(spec) {
  if (typeof spec !== "object" || spec === null) throw new TypeError("probe: arg 'spec' expected object, got " + typeof spec);

  ensure(allowed.has(spec.id), `Unknown case ID: ${spec.id}`);
  const bytes = unhex(spec.hex);
  ensure(bytes.length <= 9437184, "encoded input limit");
  emit("input", { hex: spec.hex, sha256: await digest(bytes), bytes: bytes.length });
  const yaml = await import("@std/yaml");
  emit("exports", Object.keys(yaml).sort());
  const options = { ...spec.options, onWarning: err => emit("warning", tree(err)) };
  const stage = { value: "parse" };
  try {
    const text = new TextDecoder();
    const input = text.decode(bytes);
    const value = spec.op === "parseAll" ? yaml.parseAll(input, options) : yaml.parse(input, options);
    emit("parsed", tree(value));
    if (spec.op === "alias") {
      emit("aliasBefore", value.a === value.b);
      Object.defineProperty(value.a, "x", { value: 9, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
      emit("aliasAfter", { same: value.a === value.b, bX: value.b.x });
    }
    if (spec.op === "cycle") emit("selfCycle", value.a === value.a[0]);

    if (spec.op === "rewrite" || spec.op === "edit-file") {
      stage.value = "stringify";
      const noop = yaml.stringify(value, spec.stringifyOptions);
      const edited = spec.edit === "n=2" ? { ...value, n: 2 } : value;
      const output = yaml.stringify(edited, spec.stringifyOptions);
      emit("noop", { text: noop, hex: hex(encoder.encode(noop)) });
      emit("output", { text: output, hex: hex(encoder.encode(output)) });
      emit("reparsed", tree(yaml.parse(output, options)));
      if (spec.op === "edit-file") {
        stage.value = "read-fixture";
        ensure(hex(Deno.readFileSync("inputs/source.yaml")) === spec.hex, "file matches literal fixture");
        stage.value = "write";
        const file = Deno.openSync("outputs/replacement.tmp", { createNew: true, write: true });
        try {
          const outbytes = encoder.encode(output);
          const offset = { value: 0 };
          while (offset.value < outbytes.length) {
            offset.value = offset.value + file.writeSync(outbytes.subarray(offset.value));
          }
          file.syncSync();
        } finally {
          file.close();
        }
        Deno.renameSync("outputs/replacement.tmp", "outputs/destination.yaml");
        emit("reread", tree(yaml.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("outputs/destination.yaml"), options)));
      }
    }
    emit("status", "complete");
  } catch (err) {
    errorFact(stage.value, err);
    emit("status", "error");
  }
}

  }

const encoder = new TextEncoder();
const checks = { value: 0 };
function ensure(ok, label) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

  checks.value = (n => {
    if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

    return n + 1;
  })(checks.value);
  if (!ok) throw new Error(label);

}
function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}
function appendItem(values, item) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new TypeError("appendItem: arg 'values' expected array, got " + typeof values);

  return [...values, item];
}

function recipeBytes(recipe) {
  if (typeof recipe !== "object" || recipe === null) throw new TypeError("recipeBytes: arg 'recipe' expected object, got " + typeof recipe);

  if (recipe.kind === "depth") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("[", recipe.size)}0${String.prototype.repeat.call("]", recipe.size)}

  if (recipe.kind === "string") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("x", recipe.size)}

  const lines = { value: ["base: &a0 [x,x]"] };
  const level = { value: 1 };
  while (level.value <= recipe.size) {
    const n = level.value;
    lines.value = appendItem(lines.value, `a${n}: &a${n} [*a${n - 1},*a${n - 1}]`);

  }

}

function records(path) {
  if (typeof path !== "string") throw new TypeError("records: arg 'path' expected string, got " + typeof path);

  return Deno.readTextFileSync(path).trim().split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.length > 0;
  }).map(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return JSON.parse(line);
  });
}
function facts(row) {
  if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("facts: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

  return new Map(row.stdout.trim().split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.length > 0;
  }).map(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return JSON.parse(line);
  }));
}
function entry(node, key) {
  if (typeof node !== "object" || node === null) throw new TypeError("entry: arg 'node' expected object, got " + typeof node);

  if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("entry: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

  const pair = node.entries.find(item => {
    if (!Array.isArray(item)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'item' expected array, got " + typeof item);

    const name = item[0];
    return name.value === key;
  });
  ensure(!(pair === undefined), `missing represented property ${key}`);
  return pair[1];
}
function equalFiles(a, b) {
  if (!Array.isArray(a)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'a' expected array, got " + typeof a);

  if (!Array.isArray(b)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'b' expected array, got " + typeof b);

  return JSON.stringify(a.toSorted((x, y) => {
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  })) === JSON.stringify(b.toSorted((x, y) => {
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  }));
}
function graphCheck() {
  const graph = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("dependency-graph.json"));
  const npmKeys = Object.keys(graph.npmPackages ?? {});
  ensure(npmKeys.length === 0, "npm graph");
  for (const module of graph.modules) {
    ensure(!(module.specifier.startsWith("npm:") || module.specifier.startsWith("node:")), "Node/npm module");
    ensure(!Object.hasOwn(module, "error"), "graph resolution error");
  }
  const lock = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("deno.lock"));
  ensure(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(lock.jsr)) === "[\"@std/yaml@1.2.0\"]", "one pinned package");
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ graph: "pass", modules: graph.modules.length, packages: Object.keys(lock.jsr) }));
}
async function audit() {
  graphCheck();
  const manifest = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("inputs.json"));
  const ids = new Set();
  const families = new Set();
  for (const spec of manifest.variants) {
    ensure(!ids.has(spec.id), "duplicate ID");
    ids.add(spec.id);
    if (!(spec.family === "HP")) {
      families.add(spec.family);
      const bytes = spec.inputKind === "recipe" ? recipeBytes(spec.case.recipe) : unhex(spec.case.hex);
      ensure(spec.inputSha256 === await digest(bytes), `${spec.id} original hash`);
      ensure(spec.encodedBytes === bytes.length, `${spec.id} original length`);
      ensure(spec.args[0] === JSON.stringify(spec.case), "exact case argv");
    }
  }
  ensure(families.size === 16, "all16 YAML families");
  ensure(manifest.variants.filter(v => {
    if (typeof v !== "object" || v === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'v' expected object, got " + typeof v);

    return v.family === "Y-02";
  })["length"] === 110, "scalar cross product");
  ensure(manifest.variants.filter(v => {
    if (typeof v !== "object" || v === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'v' expected object, got " + typeof v);

    return v.family === "Y-03";
  })["length"] === 50, "tag cross product");
  const specs = manifest.variants.filter(v => {
    if (typeof v !== "object" || v === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'v' expected object, got " + typeof v);

    return v.phase === "sentinel";
  });
  const runs = records("sentinel.stdout");
  ensure(runs.length === specs.length * 2, "all sentinel repeats");
  const sourceHash = await digest(Deno.readFileSync("cases.lykn"));
  const compiledHash = await digest(Deno.readFileSync("cases.js"));
  const lockHash = await digest(Deno.readFileSync("deno.lock"));
  const first = new Map();
  for (const spec of specs) {
    const pair = runs.filter(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.id === spec.id;
    });
    ensure(pair.length === 2, `${spec.id} count`);
    first.set(spec.id, pair[0]);
    if ((spec.expectedExit ?? 0) === 0) ensure(pair[0]["stdout"] === pair[1]["stdout"], `${spec.id} deterministic stdout`);

  }
  for (const row of runs) {
    const spec = specs.find(spec => {
      if (typeof spec !== "object" || spec === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'spec' expected object, got " + typeof spec);

      return spec.id === row.id;
    });
    ensure(row.exit === (spec.expectedExit ?? 0), `${row.id} exit`);
    ensure(row.stopReason === null, "no sentinel cap");
    ensure(row.survivors.length === 0, "no survivors");
    ensure(row.sourceSha256 === sourceHash, "source pin");
    ensure(row.compiledSha256 === compiledHash, "compiled pin");
    ensure(await digest(Deno.readFileSync(`${row.cwd}/deno.lock`)) === lockHash, "frozen attempt lock");
    ensure(row.stdoutSha256 === await digest(unhex(row.stdoutHex)), "stdout hash");
    ensure(row.stderrSha256 === await digest(unhex(row.stderrHex)), "stderr hash");
    ensure(equalFiles(row.inputState, row.inputAfter), "source immutable");
    for (const file of row.outputAfter) {
      ensure(file.sha256 === await digest(unhex(file.hex)), "output file hash");
    }
  }
  function fact(id, label) {
    if (typeof id !== "string") throw new TypeError("fact: arg 'id' expected string, got " + typeof id);

    if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("fact: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

    const data = facts(first.get(id));
    return data.get(label);
  }
  for (const id of ["Y-04-duplicate-reject", "Y-06-unresolved", "Y-08-two-parse", "Y-09-malformed"]) {
    const error = fact(id, "error");
    ensure(error.name === "YamlSyntaxError", `${id} expected syntax error`);
    ensure(error.stage === "parse", "error stage");
    ensure(entry(error.details, "line")["kind"] === "number", "structured error line");
  }
  for (const schema of ["default", "core", "failsafe"]) {
    for (const style of ["plain", "quoted"]) {
      const node = entry(fact(`Y-02-true-${style}-${schema}`, "parsed"), "v");
      ensure(node.kind === (style === "quoted" || schema === "failsafe" ? "string" : "boolean"), "schema scalar kind");
      ensure(node.value === "true", "true scalar represented value");
    }
  }
  ensure(fact("Y-05-alias", "aliasBefore") === true, "alias identity");
  const aliasAfter = fact("Y-05-alias", "aliasAfter");
  ensure(aliasAfter.same && aliasAfter.bX === 9, "alias edit shared");
  ensure(fact("Y-06-cycle", "selfCycle") === true, "cycle identity");
  const cycleArray = entry(fact("Y-06-cycle", "parsed"), "a");
  ensure(entry(cycleArray, "0")["id"] === cycleArray.id, "cycle reference same traversal ID");
  ensure(fact("Y-08-two-parseAll", "parsed")["length"] === 2, "two documents");
  const edited = fact("Y-01-edit", "reread");
  ensure(entry(edited, "n")["value"] === "2", "reread n=2");
  ensure(entry(edited, "name")["value"] === "Ada", "reread name");
  ensure(entry(edited, "nil")["kind"] === "null", "reread null");
  const byteReport = { value: ["# Sentinel byte audit", "", "Generated by audit.lykn; zero-based positional differing ranges [start,end), including unmatched EOF bytes. Alignment is positional, not a minimum edit script. Original/noop/edit are separate byte records."] };
  for (const id of ["Y-01-edit", "Y-10-noop", "Y-10-edit"]) {
    const spec = specs.find(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.id === id;
    });
    const input = unhex(spec.case.hex);
    for (const label of ["noop", "output"]) {
      const output = unhex(fact(id, label)["hex"]);
      const ranges = { value: [] };
      const start = { value: null };
      for (const i of Array.from({ length: Math.max(input.length, output.length) }, (ignored, i) => {
        if (typeof i !== "number" || Number.isNaN(i)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'i' expected number, got " + typeof i);

        return i;
      })) {
        const different = !(input[i] === output[i]);
        if (different && start.value === null) start.value = i;

        if (!different && !(start.value === null)) {
          ranges.value = appendItem(ranges.value, [start.value, i]);
          start.value = null;
        }
      }
      if (!(start.value === null)) ranges.value = appendItem(ranges.value, [start.value, Math.max(input.length, output.length)]);

      byteReport.value = appendItem(byteReport.value, `
## ${id} ${label}

Original ${input.length} bytes SHA256 ${await digest(input)} hex ${hex(input)}

Observed ${output.length} bytes SHA256 ${await digest(output)} hex ${hex(output)}

Differing ranges ${JSON.stringify(ranges.value)}
`);
    }
  }
  for (const row of records("controls.stdout")) {
    ensure(row.stopReason === (row.id === "control-timeout" ? "wall" : row.id === "control-output" ? "output" : "rss"), "control reason");
    ensure(row.exit === 137, "control exit");
    ensure(row.survivors.length === 0, "control cleanup");
    ensure(row.maxSampledTreeRssKiB > 0, "control observation");
    if (row.id === "control-output") ensure(row.outputBytesRetained <= 4096, "combined output bound");

  }
  const inspected = fact("HP-inspector-control", "inspector");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "0")["kind"] === "undefined", "undefined tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "1")["kind"] === "null", "null tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "3")["value"] === "-0", "negative zero tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "4")["value"] === "NaN", "NaN tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "5")["value"] === "Infinity", "Infinity tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "6")["kind"] === "date", "timestamp tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "7")["hex"] === "00ff", "binary exact");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "8")["kind"] === "map", "map keys represented separately");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "9")["kind"] === "set", "set inspected");
  ensure(fact("HP-inspector-control", "bounds")["truncated"] === true, "string bound");
  ensure(first.get("HP-unknown-case")["stderr"].includes("Unknown case ID: NOT-A-CASE"), "unknown ID explicit");
  ensure(first.get("HP-unknown-operation")["stderr"].includes("Unknown operation:"), "unknown operation explicit");
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("byte-audit.md", `${byteReport.value.join("\n")}
`);
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ result: "pass", checks: checks.value, sentinelAttempts: runs.length, frozenVariants: manifest.variants.length, yamlFamilies: families.size }));
}
if (mode === "graph") graphCheck();

if (mode === "audit") await audit();

const encoder = new TextEncoder();
function emit(label, value) {
  if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("emit: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

  const text = JSON.stringify([label, value]);
  const bytes = encoder.encode(text);
  if (bytes.length > 1048576) throw new Error("inspector output exceeds 1MiB");

  return console.log(text);
}
function ensure(ok, message) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof message !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'message' expected string, got " + typeof message);

  if (!ok) throw new Error(message);

}
function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}
function appendItem(values, item) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new TypeError("appendItem: arg 'values' expected array, got " + typeof values);

  return [...values, item];
}
function inspect(value, seen, depth) {
  if (typeof seen !== "object" || seen === null) throw new TypeError("inspect: arg 'seen' expected object, got " + typeof seen);

  if (typeof depth !== "number" || Number.isNaN(depth)) throw new TypeError("inspect: arg 'depth' expected number, got " + typeof depth);

  seen.set("visits", seen.get("visits") + 1);
  if (seen.get("visits") > 4096) return { kind: "visit-bound" };

  if (depth > 256) return { kind: "depth-bound" };

  if (value === null) return { kind: "null" };

  const kind = typeof value;
  if (kind === "number") return { kind: kind, value: Object.is(value, Number("-0")) ? "-0" : String(value), finite: Number.isFinite(value) };

  if (kind === "string") return { kind: kind, value: value.slice(0, 4096), length: value.length, truncated: value.length > 4096 };

  if (!(kind === "object")) return { kind: kind, value: String(value) };

  if (seen.has(value)) return { kind: "reference", id: seen.get(value) };

  if (seen.size >= 2048) return { kind: "node-bound" };

  const id = seen.size;
  seen.set(value, id);
  const tag = Object.prototype.toString.call(value);
  if (tag === "[object Date]") return { kind: "date", id: id, milliseconds: String(value.getTime()), iso: Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value.toISOString() };

  if (tag === "[object RegExp]") return { kind: "regexp", id: id, source: value.source, flags: value.flags };

  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return { kind: tag, id: id, byteLength: value.byteLength, hex: hex(new Uint8Array(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, Math.min(value.byteLength, 4096))), truncated: value.byteLength > 4096 };

  if (tag === "[object Map]") return { kind: "map", id: id, entries: Array.from(value).slice(0, 2048).map(pair => {
    if (!Array.isArray(pair)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'pair' expected array, got " + typeof pair);

    return [inspect(pair[0], seen, depth + 1), inspect(pair[1], seen, depth + 1)];
  }), size: value.size, truncated: value.size > 2048 };

  if (tag === "[object Set]") return { kind: "set", id: id, values: Array.from(value).slice(0, 2048).map(v => inspect(v, seen, depth + 1)), size: value.size, truncated: value.size > 2048 };

  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  return { kind: Array.isArray(value) ? "array" : "object", tag: tag, id: id, length: Array.isArray(value) ? value.length : null, truncated: keys.length > 2048, entries: keys.slice(0, 2048).map(key => {
    if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

    return [{ kind: "string", value: key }, inspect(value[key], seen, depth + 1)];
  }) };
}
function tree(value) {
  return inspect(value, new Map([["visits", 0]]), 0);
}
function errorFact(stage, err) {
  if (typeof stage !== "string") throw new TypeError("errorFact: arg 'stage' expected string, got " + typeof stage);

  return emit("error", { stage: stage, name: err.name, message: err.message, details: tree(err) });
}
function materialize(data) {
  if (typeof data !== "string") throw new TypeError("materialize: arg 'data' expected string, got " + typeof data);

  for (const item of JSON.parse(data)) {
    Deno.writeFileSync(item.path, unhex(item.hex));
  }
}
const allowed = new Set(["Y-01-edit", "Y-02-true-plain-default", "Y-02-true-plain-core", "Y-02-true-plain-failsafe", "Y-02-true-quoted-default", "Y-02-true-quoted-core", "Y-02-true-quoted-failsafe", "Y-04-duplicate-reject", "Y-05-alias", "Y-06-cycle", "Y-06-unresolved", "Y-08-two-parse", "Y-08-two-parseAll", "Y-09-malformed", "Y-10-noop", "Y-10-edit"]);
async function probe(spec) {
  if (typeof spec !== "object" || spec === null) throw new TypeError("probe: arg 'spec' expected object, got " + typeof spec);

  ensure(allowed.has(spec.id), `Unknown case ID: ${spec.id}`);
  const bytes = unhex(spec.hex);
  ensure(bytes.length <= 9437184, "encoded input limit");
  emit("input", { hex: spec.hex, sha256: await digest(bytes), bytes: bytes.length });
  const yaml = await import("@std/yaml");
  emit("exports", Object.keys(yaml).sort());
  const options = { ...spec.options, onWarning: err => emit("warning", tree(err)) };
  const stage = { value: "parse" };
  try {
    const text = new TextDecoder();
    const input = text.decode(bytes);
    const value = spec.op === "parseAll" ? yaml.parseAll(input, options) : yaml.parse(input, options);
    emit("parsed", tree(value));
    if (spec.op === "alias") {
      emit("aliasBefore", value.a === value.b);
      Object.defineProperty(value.a, "x", { value: 9, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
      emit("aliasAfter", { same: value.a === value.b, bX: value.b.x });
    }
    if (spec.op === "cycle") emit("selfCycle", value.a === value.a[0]);

    if (spec.op === "rewrite" || spec.op === "edit-file") {
      stage.value = "stringify";
      const noop = yaml.stringify(value, spec.stringifyOptions);
      const edited = spec.edit === "n=2" ? { ...value, n: 2 } : value;
      const output = yaml.stringify(edited, spec.stringifyOptions);
      emit("noop", { text: noop, hex: hex(encoder.encode(noop)) });
      emit("output", { text: output, hex: hex(encoder.encode(output)) });
      emit("reparsed", tree(yaml.parse(output, options)));
      if (spec.op === "edit-file") {
        stage.value = "read-fixture";
        ensure(hex(Deno.readFileSync("inputs/source.yaml")) === spec.hex, "file matches literal fixture");
        stage.value = "write";
        const file = Deno.openSync("outputs/replacement.tmp", { createNew: true, write: true });
        try {
          const outbytes = encoder.encode(output);
          const offset = { value: 0 };
          while (offset.value < outbytes.length) {
            offset.value = offset.value + file.writeSync(outbytes.subarray(offset.value));
          }
          file.syncSync();
        } finally {
          file.close();
        }
        Deno.renameSync("outputs/replacement.tmp", "outputs/destination.yaml");
        emit("reread", tree(yaml.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("outputs/destination.yaml"), options)));
      }
    }
    emit("status", "complete");
  } catch (err) {
    errorFact(stage.value, err);
    emit("status", "error");
  }
}
async function dispatch() {
  const op = Deno.args[0];
  const arg = Deno.args[1];
  if (op === "materialize") {
    materialize(arg);
    return;
  }
  if (op === "control-read") {
    console.log(Deno.readTextFileSync("inputs/control.txt"));
    return;
  }
  if (op === "control-timeout") {
    emit("checkpoint", "busy-loop");
    while (true) {
    }
  }
  if (op === "control-output") while (true) {
    console.log("xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx");
  }

  if (op === "control-rss") {
    await new Promise(resolve => {
      if (typeof resolve !== "function") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'resolve' expected function, got " + typeof resolve);

      return setTimeout(resolve, 3000);
    });
    return;
  }
  if (op === "probe") {
    await probe(JSON.parse(arg));
    return;
  }
  if (op === "inspector-control") {
    const cycle = {};

(func emit :args (:string label :any value) :body
  (bind text (JSON:stringify #a(label value)))

(func ensure :args (:boolean ok :string message) :body
  (if (not ok) (throw (new Error message))))
(func hex :args (:any bytes) :body
  (-> (Array:from bytes (fn (:number b) (-> (b:to-string 16) (:pad-start 2 "0")))) (:join "")))
(func unhex :args (:string text) :body
  (Uint8Array:from (?? (text:match (regex ".." "g")) #a()) (fn (:string p) (Number:parse-int p 16))))

(func inspect :args (:any value :object seen :number depth) :body
  (seen:set "visits" (+ (seen:get "visits") 1))
  (if (> (seen:get "visits") 4096) (return (obj :kind "visit-bound")))
  (if (> depth 256) (return (obj :kind "depth-bound")))
  (if (= value null) (return (obj :kind "null")))
  (bind kind (typeof value))
  (if (= kind "number")
    (return (obj :kind kind :value (? (Object:is value (Number "-0")) "-0" (String value)) :finite (Number:is-finite value))))
  (if (= kind "string")
    (return (obj :kind kind :value (value:slice 0 4096) :length value:length :truncated (> value:length 4096))))
  (if (not (= kind "object")) (return (obj :kind kind :value (String value))))
  (if (seen:has value) (return (obj :kind "reference" :id (seen:get value))))
  (if (>= seen:size 2048) (return (obj :kind "node-bound")))
  (bind id seen:size)
  (seen:set value id)
  (bind tag (Object:prototype:to-string:call value))
  (if (= tag "[object Date]")
    (return (obj :kind "date" :id id :milliseconds (String (value:get-time))
      :iso (? (Number:is-NaN (value:get-time)) null (value:toISOString)))))
  (if (= tag "[object RegExp]") (return (obj :kind "regexp" :id id :source value:source :flags value:flags)))
  (if (ArrayBuffer:is-view value)
    (return (obj :kind tag :id id :byteLength value:byteLength
      :hex (hex (new Uint8Array value:buffer value:byteOffset (Math:min value:byteLength 4096)))
      :truncated (> value:byteLength 4096))))
  (if (= tag "[object Map]")
    (return (obj :kind "map" :id id :entries
      (-> (Array:from value) (:slice 0 2048) (:map (fn (:array pair)
        #a((inspect (get pair 0) seen (+ depth 1)) (inspect (get pair 1) seen (+ depth 1))))))
      :size value:size :truncated (> value:size 2048))))
  (if (= tag "[object Set]")
    (return (obj :kind "set" :id id :values
      (-> (Array:from value) (:slice 0 2048) (:map (fn (:any v) (inspect v seen (+ depth 1)))))
      :size value:size :truncated (> value:size 2048))))
  (bind keys (Object:keys value))
  (obj :kind (? (Array:is-array value) "array" "object") :tag tag :id id
    :length (? (Array:is-array value) value:length null) :truncated (> keys:length 2048)
    :entries (-> keys (:slice 0 2048) (:map (fn (:string key)
      #a((obj :kind "string" :value key) (inspect (get value key) seen (+ depth 1))))))))
(func tree :args (:any value) :body (inspect value (new Map #a(#a("visits" 0))) 0))
(func error-fact :args (:string stage :any err) :body
  (emit "error" (obj :stage stage :name err:name :message err:message
    :details (tree err))))
(func materialize :args (:string data) :body
  (for-of item (JSON:parse data)
    (Deno:write-file-sync item:path (unhex item:hex))))
(bind allowed (new Set #a("Y-01-edit" "Y-02-true-plain-default" "Y-02-true-plain-core"
  "Y-02-true-plain-failsafe" "Y-02-true-quoted-default" "Y-02-true-quoted-core"
  "Y-02-true-quoted-failsafe" "Y-04-duplicate-reject" "Y-05-alias" "Y-06-cycle"
  "Y-06-unresolved" "Y-08-two-parse" "Y-08-two-parseAll" "Y-09-malformed"
  "Y-10-noop" "Y-10-edit")))
(async (func probe :args (:object spec) :body
  (ensure (allowed:has spec:id) (template "Unknown case ID: " spec:id))
  (bind bytes (unhex spec:hex))
  (ensure (<= bytes:length 9437184) "encoded input limit")
  (emit "input" (obj :hex spec:hex :sha256 (await (digest bytes)) :bytes bytes:length))
  (bind yaml (await (dynamic-import "@std/yaml")))
  (emit "exports" (-> (Object:keys yaml) (:sort)))
  (bind options (assoc spec:options :onWarning (fn (:any err) (emit "warning" (tree err)))))
  (bind stage (cell "parse"))
  (try
    (bind text (new TextDecoder))
    (bind input (text:decode bytes))
    (bind value (? (= spec:op "parseAll") (yaml:parse-all input options) (yaml:parse input options)))
    (emit "parsed" (tree value))
    (if (= spec:op "alias")
      (do (emit "aliasBefore" (= value:a value:b))
          (Object:define-property value:a "x" (obj :value 9 :writable true :enumerable true :configurable true))
          (emit "aliasAfter" (obj :same (= value:a value:b) :bX value:b:x))))
    (if (= spec:op "cycle") (emit "selfCycle" (= value:a (get value:a 0))))
    (if (or (= spec:op "rewrite") (= spec:op "edit-file"))
      (do (reset! stage "stringify")
          (bind noop (yaml:stringify value spec:stringifyOptions))
          (bind edited (? (= spec:edit "n=2") (assoc value :n 2) value))
          (bind output (yaml:stringify edited spec:stringifyOptions))
          (emit "noop" (obj :text noop :hex (hex (encoder:encode noop))))
          (emit "output" (obj :text output :hex (hex (encoder:encode output))))
          (emit "reparsed" (tree (yaml:parse output options)))
          (if (= spec:op "edit-file")
            (do (reset! stage "read-fixture")
                (ensure (= (hex (Deno:read-file-sync "inputs/source.yaml")) spec:hex) "file matches literal fixture")
                (reset! stage "write")
                (bind file (Deno:open-sync "outputs/replacement.tmp" (obj :create-new true :write true)))
                (try (bind outbytes (encoder:encode output)) (bind offset (cell 0))
                  (while (< (express offset) outbytes:length)
                    (swap! offset + (file:write-sync (outbytes:subarray (express offset)))))
                  (file:sync-sync) (finally (file:close)))
                (Deno:rename-sync "outputs/replacement.tmp" "outputs/destination.yaml")
                (emit "reread" (tree (yaml:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "outputs/destination.yaml") options)))))))
    (emit "status" "complete")
    (catch err (error-fact (express stage) err) (emit "status" "error")))))
(async (func dispatch :args () :body
  (bind op (get Deno:args 0))
  (bind arg (get Deno:args 1))
  (if (= op "materialize") (do (materialize arg) (return)))
  (if (= op "control-read") (do (console:log (Deno:read-text-file-sync "inputs/control.txt")) (return)))
  (if (= op "control-timeout") (do (emit "checkpoint" "busy-loop") (while true)))
  (if (= op "control-output") (while true (console:log "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx")))
  (if (= op "control-rss") (do (await (new Promise (fn (:function resolve) (set-timeout resolve 3000)))) (return)))
  (if (= op "probe") (do (await (probe (JSON:parse arg))) (return)))
  (if (= op "inspector-control")
    (do (bind cycle (obj)) (Object:define-property cycle "self" (obj :value cycle :enumerable true))
        (emit "inspector" (tree #a(undefined null false (Number "-0") NaN Infinity
          (new Date "2026-09-12T00:00:00Z") (Uint8Array:of 0 255)
          (new Map #a(#a(true "boolean-key") #a(1 "number-key")))
          (new Set #a(1 2)) cycle (Symbol "s") (fn () 1) (new Array 2))))
        (emit "bounds" (tree (String:prototype:repeat:call "x" 4097)))
        (bind nested (cell 0))
        (for-of i (Array:from (obj :length 258) (fn (:any ignored :number i) i))
          (reset! nested #a((express nested))))
        (emit "depthBound" (tree (express nested)))
        (return)))
  (throw (new Error (template "Unknown operation: " op)))))
(await (dispatch))

(func emit :args (:any record) :body (console:log (JSON:stringify record)))

(func copy-tree :args (:string from :string to) :body
  (Deno:mkdir-sync to (obj :recursive true))
  (for-of entry (Deno:read-dir-sync from)
    (bind src (template from "/" entry:name))
    (bind dest (template to "/" entry:name))
    (if entry:is-directory (copy-tree src dest) (Deno:copy-file-sync src dest)))
  null)
(async (func snapshot :args (:string root :string relative) :body
  (bind records (cell #a()))
  (for-of entry (Deno:read-dir-sync (template root "/" relative))
    (bind path (template relative "/" entry:name))
    (bind full (template root "/" path))
    (bind info (Deno:lstat-sync full))
    (if info:is-symlink (throw (new Error "symlink escaped fixture contract")))
    (if info:is-directory
      (do (swap! records append-item (obj :path path :directory true :mode info:mode))
          (bind children (await (snapshot root path)))
          (swap! records (fn (:array old) (old:concat children))))
      (try
        (bind bytes (Deno:read-file-sync full))
        (swap! records append-item (obj :path path :mode info:mode :size bytes:length
          :hex (hex bytes) :sha256 (await (digest bytes))))
        (catch err (swap! records append-item (obj :path path :mode info:mode :error err:message))))))
  (express records)))
(func processes :args () :body
  (bind out (-> (command "/bin/ps" #a("-axo" "pid=,ppid=,rss=,stat=") seed) (:output-sync)))
  (if (not out:success) (throw (new Error "ps observation unavailable")))
  (-> (decoder:decode out:stdout) (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:map (fn (:string line)
      (bind parts (-> line (:trim) (:split (regex "\\s+"))))
      (obj :pid (Number (get parts 0)) :ppid (Number (get parts 1))
        :rss (Number (get parts 2)) :state (get parts 3))))))
(func descendants :args (:array table :number parent) :body
  (bind ids (new Set #a(parent)))
  (bind changed (cell true))
  (while (express changed)
    (reset! changed false)
    (for-of row table
      (? (and (ids:has row:ppid) (not (ids:has row:pid)))
        (do (ids:add row:pid) (reset! changed true)) undefined)))
  (table:filter (fn (:object row) (ids:has row:pid))))

(async (func run-one :args (:object spec :number attempt) :body
  (bind root (template seed "/runs/" spec:id "-" attempt))
  (Deno:mkdir-sync root (obj :recursive true))

    (:concat #a("cases.lykn" spec:op)) (:concat spec:args)))

  (bind done (cell false))
  (bind reason (cell null))

  (bind kills (cell #a()))
  (async (func stop :args (:string why) :body
    (if (not (= (express reason) null)) (return))
    (reset! reason why)
    (bind table (processes))
    (bind owned (descendants table child:pid))
    (for-of row owned (known:add row:pid))
    (bind targets (-> (Array:from known) (:reverse) (:map (fn (:number pid) (String pid)))))
    (bind out (await (-> (command "/bin/kill" (-> #a("-KILL") (:concat targets)) root) (:output))))
    (swap! kills append-item (obj :targets targets :exit out:code :stderr (decoder:decode out:stderr)))))
  (async (func collect :args (:any stream) :body
    (bind chunks (cell #a()))
    (bind reader (stream:get-reader))
    (bind item (cell (await (reader:read))))
    (while (not (get (express item) "done"))
      (bind bytes (get (express item) "value"))
      (swap! total + bytes:length)
      (bind keep (bytes:slice 0 (Math:max 0 (- cap (express stored)))))
      (swap! stored + keep:length)
      (swap! chunks append-item keep)
      (? (> (express total) cap) (await (stop "output")) undefined)
      (reset! item (await (reader:read))))
    (reader:release-lock)
    (bind result (new Uint8Array (-> (express chunks) (:reduce (fn (:number n :any b) (+ n b:length)) 0))))
    (bind offset (cell 0))
    (for-of chunk (express chunks) (result:set chunk (express offset)) (swap! offset + chunk:length))
    result))
  (async (func watch :args () :body
    (while (not (express done))
      (bind rows (descendants (processes) child:pid))
      (for-of row rows (known:add row:pid))
      (bind rss (rows:reduce (fn (:number n :object row) (+ n row:rss)) 0))
      (swap! peak Math:max rss)
      (swap! samples append-item (obj :ms (- (performance:now) start) :rssKiB rss :processes rows))
      (? (> rss rss-cap) (await (stop "rss")) undefined)
      (? (> (- (performance:now) start) wall) (await (stop "wall")) undefined)
      (await (delay 25)))
    null))
  (bind observed-status (-> child:status (:then (fn (:any status) (reset! done true) status))))
  (bind results (await (Promise:all #a((collect child:stdout) (collect child:stderr) observed-status (watch)))))
  (bind stdout (get results 0))
  (bind stderr (get results 1))
  (bind status (get results 2))
  (bind ended (new Date))
  (bind survivors (-> (processes) (:filter (fn (:object row)
    (and (known:has row:pid) (not (row:state:starts-with "Z")))))))
  (bind record (obj :id spec:id :attempt attempt :phase spec:phase :expected spec:expected
    :cwd root :utcStart (started:toISOString) :utcEnd (ended:toISOString)
    :command (-> #a("/usr/bin/time" "-l" CLI) (:concat args)) :environment (environment root)
    :wallMs (- (performance:now) start) :exit status:code :signal status:signal
    :stopReason (express reason) :outputBytesObserved (express total) :outputBytesRetained (express stored)
    :maxSampledTreeRssKiB (express peak) :samples (express samples) :kills (express kills) :survivors survivors
    :stdout (decoder:decode stdout) :stderr (decoder:decode stderr)
    :stdoutHex (hex stdout) :stderrHex (hex stderr)
    :stdoutSha256 (await (digest stdout)) :stderrSha256 (await (digest stderr))
    :inputState before :outputBefore before-out :inputAfter (await (snapshot root "inputs"))
    :outputAfter (await (snapshot root "outputs"))
    :sourceSha256 (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync (template root "/cases.lykn"))))
    :compiledSha256 (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync (template root "/target/lykn/run/cases.js"))))
    :configText (Deno:read-text-file-sync (template root "/project.json"))
    :preparation (obj :command (-> #a(CLI) (:concat prep-args)) :exit prep:code
      :stdout (decoder:decode prep:stdout) :stderr (decoder:decode prep:stderr))))
  (emit record)
  record))

        :args #a() :files #a() :flags #a() :expected (template "supervisor stops for " kind)
        :wallMs 500 :outputBytes (? (= kind "output") 4096 16777216)
        :rssKiB (? (= kind "rss") 1 524288)))
      (bind result (await (run-one spec 1)))
      (if (or (not (= result:stopReason (? (= kind "timeout") "wall" kind))) (> result:survivors:length 0) (= result:maxSampledTreeRssKiB 0))
        (throw (new Error "Supervisor control did not establish bounded termination"))))
    (Deno:write-text-file-sync "supervisor-verified.txt" "wall/output/RSS controls passed\n")))
(if (not (= group "controls"))
  (do
    (Deno:read-text-file-sync "supervisor-verified.txt")
    (bind blocked (new Set))
    (for-of spec manifest:variants
      (if (= spec:phase group)
        (do
          (if (blocked:has spec:family)
            (emit (obj :id spec:id :phase group :notRun "earlier family cap or harness failure"))
            (do
              (bind attempt (cell 1))
              (while (<= (express attempt) spec:repeats)
                (bind result (await (run-one spec (express attempt))))
                (? (and (not (= result:stopReason null)) (not (= result:stopReason spec:expectedStop)))
                  (blocked:add spec:family) undefined)
                (? (and (not (= result:exit (?? spec:expectedExit 0))) (= result:stopReason null))
                  (blocked:add spec:family) undefined)
                (swap! attempt (fn (:number n) (+ n 1)))
                (? (blocked:has spec:family) (reset! attempt (+ spec:repeats 1)) undefined)))))))))

(func recipe-bytes :args (:object recipe) :body
  (if (= recipe:kind "depth")
    (return (encoder:encode (template (String:prototype:repeat:call "[" recipe:size) "0" (String:prototype:repeat:call "]" recipe:size) "\n"))))
  (if (= recipe:kind "string")
    (return (encoder:encode (template (String:prototype:repeat:call "x" recipe:size) "\n"))))
  (bind lines (cell #a("base: &a0 [x,x]")))
  (bind level (cell 1))
  (while (<= (express level) recipe:size)
    (bind n (express level))
    (swap! lines append-item (template "a" n ": &a" n " [*a" (- n 1) ",*a" (- n 1) "]"))
    (swap! level (fn (:number current) (+ current 1))))
  (encoder:encode (template (-> (express lines) (:join "\n")) "\n")))

(func records :args (:string path) :body
  (-> (Deno:read-text-file-sync path) (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0))) (:map (fn (:string line) (JSON:parse line)))))
(func facts :args (:object row) :body
  (new Map (-> row:stdout (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0))) (:map (fn (:string line) (JSON:parse line))))))
(func entry :args (:object node :string key) :body
  (bind pair (node:entries:find (fn (:array item) (bind name (get item 0)) (= name:value key))))
  (ensure (not (= pair undefined)) (template "missing represented property " key))
  (get pair 1))
(func equal-files :args (:array a :array b) :body
  (= (JSON:stringify (a:to-sorted (fn (:object x :object y) (x:path:locale-compare y:path))))
    (JSON:stringify (b:to-sorted (fn (:object x :object y) (x:path:locale-compare y:path))))))
(func graph-check :args () :body

  (bind npm-keys (Object:keys (?? graph:npmPackages (obj))))

  (for-of module graph:modules
    (ensure (not (or (module:specifier:starts-with "npm:") (module:specifier:starts-with "node:"))) "Node/npm module")
    (ensure (not (Object:has-own module "error")) "graph resolution error"))
  (bind lock (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "deno.lock")))
  (ensure (= (JSON:stringify (Object:keys lock:jsr)) "[\"@std/yaml@1.2.0\"]") "one pinned package")

(async (func audit :args () :body
  (graph-check)

  (bind runs (records "sentinel.stdout"))

  (bind compiled-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "cases.js"))))
  (bind lock-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "deno.lock"))))
  (bind first (new Map))
  (for-of spec specs
    (bind pair (runs:filter (fn (:object row) (= row:id spec:id))))
    (ensure (= pair:length 2) (template spec:id " count"))
    (ensure (= (JSON:stringify (pair:map (fn (:object row) row:attempt))) "[1,2]") "attempt identities")
    (first:set spec:id (get pair 0))
    (if (= (?? spec:expectedExit 0) 0)
      (ensure (= (get (get pair 0) "stdout") (get (get pair 1) "stdout")) (template spec:id " deterministic stdout"))))
  (for-of row runs
    (bind spec (specs:find (fn (:object spec) (= spec:id row:id))))
    (ensure (= row:exit (?? spec:expectedExit 0)) (template row:id " exit"))

    (ensure (= (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync (template row:cwd "/deno.lock")))) lock-hash) "frozen attempt lock")
    (ensure (= row:stdoutSha256 (await (digest (unhex row:stdoutHex)))) "stdout hash")
    (ensure (= row:stderrSha256 (await (digest (unhex row:stderrHex)))) "stderr hash")
    (ensure (equal-files row:inputState row:inputAfter) "source immutable")
    (if (not (= row:id "Y-01-edit"))
      (ensure (equal-files row:outputBefore row:outputAfter) "non-file probe leaves outputs unchanged"))
    (for-of file row:outputAfter
      (ensure (= file:sha256 (await (digest (unhex file:hex)))) "output file hash")))
  (func fact :args (:string id :string label) :body (bind data (facts (first:get id))) (data:get label))
  (for-of id #a("Y-04-duplicate-reject" "Y-06-unresolved" "Y-08-two-parse" "Y-09-malformed")
    (bind error (fact id "error"))
    (ensure (= error:name "YamlSyntaxError") (template id " expected syntax error"))
    (ensure (= error:stage "parse") "error stage")

      (bind node (entry (fact (template "Y-02-true-" style "-" schema) "parsed") "v"))
      (ensure (= node:kind (? (or (= style "quoted") (= schema "failsafe")) "string" "boolean")) "schema scalar kind")
      (ensure (= node:value "true") "true scalar represented value")))
  (ensure (= (fact "Y-05-alias" "aliasBefore") true) "alias identity")

  (for-of id #a("Y-01-edit" "Y-10-noop" "Y-10-edit")

    (bind input (unhex spec:case:hex))

function ensure(ok, message) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof message !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'message' expected string, got " + typeof message);

function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}

function inspect(value, seen, depth) {
  if (typeof seen !== "object" || seen === null) throw new TypeError("inspect: arg 'seen' expected object, got " + typeof seen);

  if (typeof depth !== "number" || Number.isNaN(depth)) throw new TypeError("inspect: arg 'depth' expected number, got " + typeof depth);

  seen.set("visits", seen.get("visits") + 1);
  if (seen.get("visits") > 4096) return { kind: "visit-bound" };

  if (depth > 256) return { kind: "depth-bound" };

  if (value === null) return { kind: "null" };

  const kind = typeof value;
  if (kind === "number") return { kind: kind, value: Object.is(value, Number("-0")) ? "-0" : String(value), finite: Number.isFinite(value) };

  if (kind === "string") return { kind: kind, value: value.slice(0, 4096), length: value.length, truncated: value.length > 4096 };

  if (!(kind === "object")) return { kind: kind, value: String(value) };

  if (seen.has(value)) return { kind: "reference", id: seen.get(value) };

  if (seen.size >= 2048) return { kind: "node-bound" };

  const id = seen.size;
  seen.set(value, id);
  const tag = Object.prototype.toString.call(value);
  if (tag === "[object Date]") return { kind: "date", id: id, milliseconds: String(value.getTime()), iso: Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? null : value.toISOString() };

  if (tag === "[object RegExp]") return { kind: "regexp", id: id, source: value.source, flags: value.flags };

  if (ArrayBuffer.isView(value)) return { kind: tag, id: id, byteLength: value.byteLength, hex: hex(new Uint8Array(value.buffer, value.byteOffset, Math.min(value.byteLength, 4096))), truncated: value.byteLength > 4096 };

  if (tag === "[object Map]") return { kind: "map", id: id, entries: Array.from(value).slice(0, 2048).map(pair => {
    if (!Array.isArray(pair)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'pair' expected array, got " + typeof pair);

    return [inspect(pair[0], seen, depth + 1), inspect(pair[1], seen, depth + 1)];
  }), size: value.size, truncated: value.size > 2048 };

  if (tag === "[object Set]") return { kind: "set", id: id, values: Array.from(value).slice(0, 2048).map(v => inspect(v, seen, depth + 1)), size: value.size, truncated: value.size > 2048 };

  const keys = Object.keys(value);
  return { kind: Array.isArray(value) ? "array" : "object", tag: tag, id: id, length: Array.isArray(value) ? value.length : null, truncated: keys.length > 2048, entries: keys.slice(0, 2048).map(key => {
    if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

    return [{ kind: "string", value: key }, inspect(value[key], seen, depth + 1)];
  }) };
}
function tree(value) {
  return inspect(value, new Map([["visits", 0]]), 0);
}

  return emit("error", { stage: stage, name: err.name, message: err.message, details: tree(err) });
}

  }
}

async function probe(spec) {
  if (typeof spec !== "object" || spec === null) throw new TypeError("probe: arg 'spec' expected object, got " + typeof spec);

  ensure(allowed.has(spec.id), `Unknown case ID: ${spec.id}`);
  const bytes = unhex(spec.hex);
  ensure(bytes.length <= 9437184, "encoded input limit");
  emit("input", { hex: spec.hex, sha256: await digest(bytes), bytes: bytes.length });
  const yaml = await import("@std/yaml");
  emit("exports", Object.keys(yaml).sort());
  const options = { ...spec.options, onWarning: err => emit("warning", tree(err)) };
  const stage = { value: "parse" };
  try {
    const text = new TextDecoder();
    const input = text.decode(bytes);
    const value = spec.op === "parseAll" ? yaml.parseAll(input, options) : yaml.parse(input, options);
    emit("parsed", tree(value));
    if (spec.op === "alias") {
      emit("aliasBefore", value.a === value.b);
      Object.defineProperty(value.a, "x", { value: 9, writable: true, enumerable: true, configurable: true });
      emit("aliasAfter", { same: value.a === value.b, bX: value.b.x });
    }
    if (spec.op === "cycle") emit("selfCycle", value.a === value.a[0]);

    if (spec.op === "rewrite" || spec.op === "edit-file") {
      stage.value = "stringify";
      const noop = yaml.stringify(value, spec.stringifyOptions);
      const edited = spec.edit === "n=2" ? { ...value, n: 2 } : value;
      const output = yaml.stringify(edited, spec.stringifyOptions);
      emit("noop", { text: noop, hex: hex(encoder.encode(noop)) });
      emit("output", { text: output, hex: hex(encoder.encode(output)) });
      emit("reparsed", tree(yaml.parse(output, options)));
      if (spec.op === "edit-file") {
        stage.value = "read-fixture";
        ensure(hex(Deno.readFileSync("inputs/source.yaml")) === spec.hex, "file matches literal fixture");
        stage.value = "write";
        const file = Deno.openSync("outputs/replacement.tmp", { createNew: true, write: true });
        try {
          const outbytes = encoder.encode(output);
          const offset = { value: 0 };
          while (offset.value < outbytes.length) {
            offset.value = offset.value + file.writeSync(outbytes.subarray(offset.value));
          }
          file.syncSync();
        } finally {
          file.close();
        }
        Deno.renameSync("outputs/replacement.tmp", "outputs/destination.yaml");
        emit("reread", tree(yaml.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("outputs/destination.yaml"), options)));
      }
    }
    emit("status", "complete");
  } catch (err) {
    errorFact(stage.value, err);
    emit("status", "error");
  }
}

async function snapshot(root, relative) {
  if (typeof root !== "string") throw new TypeError("snapshot: arg 'root' expected string, got " + typeof root);

  if (typeof relative !== "string") throw new TypeError("snapshot: arg 'relative' expected string, got " + typeof relative);

  const records = { value: [] };
  for (const entry of Deno.readDirSync(`${root}/${relative}`)) {
    const path = `${relative}/${entry.name}`;
    const full = `${root}/${path}`;
    const info = Deno.lstatSync(full);
    if (info.isSymlink) throw new Error("symlink escaped fixture contract");

    if (info.isDirectory) {
      records.value = appendItem(records.value, { path: path, directory: true, mode: info.mode });
      const children = await snapshot(root, path);
      records.value = (old => {
        if (!Array.isArray(old)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'old' expected array, got " + typeof old);

        return old.concat(children);
      })(records.value);
    } else try {
      const bytes = Deno.readFileSync(full);
      records.value = appendItem(records.value, { path: path, mode: info.mode, size: bytes.length, hex: hex(bytes), sha256: await digest(bytes) });
    } catch (err) {
      records.value = appendItem(records.value, { path: path, mode: info.mode, error: err.message });
    }

  }

}

function descendants(table, parent) {
  if (!Array.isArray(table)) throw new TypeError("descendants: arg 'table' expected array, got " + typeof table);

  if (typeof parent !== "number" || Number.isNaN(parent)) throw new TypeError("descendants: arg 'parent' expected number, got " + typeof parent);

  const ids = new Set([parent]);
  const changed = { value: true };
  while (changed.value) {
    changed.value = false;
    for (const row of table) {
      ids.has(row.ppid) && !ids.has(row.pid) ? (() => {
        ids.add(row.pid);
        return changed.value = true;
      })() : undefined;
    }
  }
  return table.filter(row => {
    if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

    return ids.has(row.pid);
  });
}

function ensure(ok, label) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

    return n + 1;
  })(checks.value);

function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}

function recipeBytes(recipe) {

  if (recipe.kind === "string") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("x", recipe.size)}

  const lines = { value: ["base: &a0 [x,x]"] };
  const level = { value: 1 };
  while (level.value <= recipe.size) {
    const n = level.value;

}

  if (typeof path !== "string") throw new TypeError("records: arg 'path' expected string, got " + typeof path);

  return Deno.readTextFileSync(path).trim().split("\n").filter(line => {

}

function equalFiles(a, b) {
  if (!Array.isArray(a)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'a' expected array, got " + typeof a);

    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  })) === JSON.stringify(b.toSorted((x, y) => {

(func recipe-bytes :args (:object recipe) :body
  (if (= recipe:kind "depth")
    (return (encoder:encode (template (String:prototype:repeat:call "[" recipe:size) "0" (String:prototype:repeat:call "]" recipe:size) "\n"))))
  (if (= recipe:kind "string")
    (return (encoder:encode (template (String:prototype:repeat:call "x" recipe:size) "\n"))))
  (bind lines (cell #a("base: &a0 [x,x]")))
  (bind level (cell 1))
  (while (<= (express level) recipe:size)
    (bind n (express level))
    (swap! lines append-item (template "a" n ": &a" n " [*a" (- n 1) ",*a" (- n 1) "]"))
    (swap! level (fn (:number current) (+ current 1))))
  (encoder:encode (template (-> (express lines) (:join "\n")) "\n")))

(func records :args (:string path) :body
  (-> (Deno:read-text-file-sync path) (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0))) (:map (fn (:string line) (JSON:parse line)))))
(func facts :args (:object row) :body
  (new Map (-> row:stdout (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0))) (:map (fn (:string line) (JSON:parse line))))))
(func entry :args (:object node :string key) :body
  (bind pair (node:entries:find (fn (:array item) (bind name (get item 0)) (= name:value key))))
  (ensure (not (= pair undefined)) (template "missing represented property " key))
  (get pair 1))
(func equal-files :args (:array a :array b) :body
  (= (JSON:stringify (a:to-sorted (fn (:object x :object y) (x:path:locale-compare y:path))))
    (JSON:stringify (b:to-sorted (fn (:object x :object y) (x:path:locale-compare y:path))))))
(func graph-check :args () :body
  (bind graph (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "dependency-graph.json")))
  (bind npm-keys (Object:keys (?? graph:npmPackages (obj))))
  (ensure (= npm-keys:length 0) "npm graph")
  (for-of module graph:modules
    (ensure (not (or (module:specifier:starts-with "npm:") (module:specifier:starts-with "node:"))) "Node/npm module")
    (ensure (not (Object:has-own module "error")) "graph resolution error"))
  (bind lock (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "deno.lock")))

  (console:log (JSON:stringify (obj :graph "pass" :modules graph:modules:length :packages (Object:keys lock:jsr)))))
(async (func audit :args () :body
  (graph-check)
  (bind manifest (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "inputs.json")))
  (bind ids (new Set))
  (bind families (new Set))
  (for-of spec manifest:variants
    (ensure (not (ids:has spec:id)) "duplicate ID") (ids:add spec:id)
    (if (not (= spec:family "HP"))
      (do (families:add spec:family)
          (bind bytes (? (= spec:inputKind "recipe") (recipe-bytes spec:case:recipe) (unhex spec:case:hex)))
          (ensure (= spec:inputSha256 (await (digest bytes))) (template spec:id " original hash"))
          (ensure (= spec:encodedBytes bytes:length) (template spec:id " original length"))
          (ensure (= (get spec:args 0) (JSON:stringify spec:case)) "exact case argv"))))
  (ensure (= families:size 16) "all16 YAML families")
  (ensure (= (get (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object v) (= v:family "Y-02"))) "length") 110) "scalar cross product")
  (ensure (= (get (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object v) (= v:family "Y-03"))) "length") 50) "tag cross product")
  (bind specs (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object v) (= v:phase "sentinel"))))
  (bind runs (records "sentinel.stdout"))
  (ensure (= runs:length (* specs:length 2)) "all sentinel repeats")
  (bind source-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "cases.lykn"))))
  (bind compiled-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "cases.js"))))
  (bind lock-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "deno.lock"))))
  (bind first (new Map))
  (for-of spec specs
    (bind pair (runs:filter (fn (:object row) (= row:id spec:id))))
    (ensure (= pair:length 2) (template spec:id " count"))
    (first:set spec:id (get pair 0))
    (if (= (?? spec:expectedExit 0) 0)
      (ensure (= (get (get pair 0) "stdout") (get (get pair 1) "stdout")) (template spec:id " deterministic stdout"))))
  (for-of row runs
    (bind spec (specs:find (fn (:object spec) (= spec:id row:id))))
    (ensure (= row:exit (?? spec:expectedExit 0)) (template row:id " exit"))
    (ensure (= row:stopReason null) "no sentinel cap")
    (ensure (= row:survivors:length 0) "no survivors")
    (ensure (= row:sourceSha256 source-hash) "source pin")
    (ensure (= row:compiledSha256 compiled-hash) "compiled pin")
    (ensure (= (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync (template row:cwd "/deno.lock")))) lock-hash) "frozen attempt lock")
    (ensure (= row:stdoutSha256 (await (digest (unhex row:stdoutHex)))) "stdout hash")
    (ensure (= row:stderrSha256 (await (digest (unhex row:stderrHex)))) "stderr hash")
    (ensure (equal-files row:inputState row:inputAfter) "source immutable")
    (for-of file row:outputAfter
      (ensure (= file:sha256 (await (digest (unhex file:hex)))) "output file hash")))
  (func fact :args (:string id :string label) :body (bind data (facts (first:get id))) (data:get label))
  (for-of id #a("Y-04-duplicate-reject" "Y-06-unresolved" "Y-08-two-parse" "Y-09-malformed")
    (bind error (fact id "error"))
    (ensure (= error:name "YamlSyntaxError") (template id " expected syntax error"))
    (ensure (= error:stage "parse") "error stage")
    (ensure (= (get (entry error:details "line") "kind") "number") "structured error line"))
  (for-of schema #a("default" "core" "failsafe")
    (for-of style #a("plain" "quoted")
      (bind node (entry (fact (template "Y-02-true-" style "-" schema) "parsed") "v"))
      (ensure (= node:kind (? (or (= style "quoted") (= schema "failsafe")) "string" "boolean")) "schema scalar kind")
      (ensure (= node:value "true") "true scalar represented value")))
  (ensure (= (fact "Y-05-alias" "aliasBefore") true) "alias identity")
  (bind alias-after (fact "Y-05-alias" "aliasAfter"))
  (ensure (and alias-after:same (= alias-after:bX 9)) "alias edit shared")
  (ensure (= (fact "Y-06-cycle" "selfCycle") true) "cycle identity")
  (bind cycle-array (entry (fact "Y-06-cycle" "parsed") "a"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry cycle-array "0") "id") cycle-array:id) "cycle reference same traversal ID")
  (ensure (= (get (fact "Y-08-two-parseAll" "parsed") "length") 2) "two documents")
  (bind edited (fact "Y-01-edit" "reread"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry edited "n") "value") "2") "reread n=2")
  (ensure (= (get (entry edited "name") "value") "Ada") "reread name")
  (ensure (= (get (entry edited "nil") "kind") "null") "reread null")
  (bind byte-report (cell #a("# Sentinel byte audit" "" "Generated by audit.lykn; zero-based positional differing ranges [start,end), including unmatched EOF bytes. Alignment is positional, not a minimum edit script. Original/noop/edit are separate byte records.")))
  (for-of id #a("Y-01-edit" "Y-10-noop" "Y-10-edit")
    (bind spec (specs:find (fn (:object row) (= row:id id))))
    (bind input (unhex spec:case:hex))
    (for-of label #a("noop" "output")
      (bind output (unhex (get (fact id label) "hex")))
      (bind ranges (cell #a())) (bind start (cell null))
      (for-of i (Array:from (obj :length (Math:max input:length output:length)) (fn (:any ignored :number i) i))
        (bind different (not (= (get input i) (get output i))))
        (if (and different (= (express start) null)) (reset! start i))
        (if (and (not different) (not (= (express start) null)))
          (do (swap! ranges append-item #a((express start) i)) (reset! start null))))
      (if (not (= (express start) null)) (swap! ranges append-item #a((express start) (Math:max input:length output:length))))
      (swap! byte-report append-item (template "\n## " id " " label "\n\nOriginal " input:length " bytes SHA256 " (await (digest input)) " hex " (hex input)
        "\n\nObserved " output:length " bytes SHA256 " (await (digest output)) " hex " (hex output)
        "\n\nDiffering ranges " (JSON:stringify (express ranges)) "\n"))))
  (for-of row (records "controls.stdout")
    (ensure (= row:stopReason (? (= row:id "control-timeout") "wall" (? (= row:id "control-output") "output" "rss"))) "control reason")
    (ensure (= row:exit 137) "control exit")
    (ensure (= row:survivors:length 0) "control cleanup")
    (ensure (> row:maxSampledTreeRssKiB 0) "control observation")
    (if (= row:id "control-output") (ensure (<= row:outputBytesRetained 4096) "combined output bound")))
  (bind inspected (fact "HP-inspector-control" "inspector"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "0") "kind") "undefined") "undefined tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "1") "kind") "null") "null tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "3") "value") "-0") "negative zero tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "4") "value") "NaN") "NaN tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "5") "value") "Infinity") "Infinity tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "6") "kind") "date") "timestamp tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "7") "hex") "00ff") "binary exact")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "8") "kind") "map") "map keys represented separately")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "9") "kind") "set") "set inspected")
  (ensure (= (get (fact "HP-inspector-control" "bounds") "truncated") true) "string bound")
  (ensure (-> (first:get "HP-unknown-case") (get "stderr") (:includes "Unknown case ID: NOT-A-CASE")) "unknown ID explicit")
  (ensure (-> (first:get "HP-unknown-operation") (get "stderr") (:includes "Unknown operation:")) "unknown operation explicit")
  (Deno:write-text-file-sync "byte-audit.md" (template (-> (express byte-report) (:join "\n")) "\n"))
  (console:log (JSON:stringify (obj :result "pass" :checks (express checks) :sentinelAttempts runs:length :frozenVariants manifest:variants:length :yamlFamilies families:size)))))
(if (= mode "graph") (graph-check))
(if (= mode "audit") (await (audit)))

END FILE

const encoder = new TextEncoder();
const checks = { value: 0 };
function ensure(ok, label) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

  checks.value = (n => {
    if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

    return n + 1;
  })(checks.value);
  if (!ok) throw new Error(label);

}
function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}
function appendItem(values, item) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new TypeError("appendItem: arg 'values' expected array, got " + typeof values);

  return [...values, item];
}

function recipeBytes(recipe) {
  if (typeof recipe !== "object" || recipe === null) throw new TypeError("recipeBytes: arg 'recipe' expected object, got " + typeof recipe);

  if (recipe.kind === "depth") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("[", recipe.size)}0${String.prototype.repeat.call("]", recipe.size)}
`);

  if (recipe.kind === "string") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("x", recipe.size)}
`);

  const lines = { value: ["base: &a0 [x,x]"] };
  const level = { value: 1 };
  while (level.value <= recipe.size) {
    const n = level.value;
    lines.value = appendItem(lines.value, `a${n}: &a${n} [*a${n - 1},*a${n - 1}]`);
    level.value = (current => {
      if (typeof current !== "number" || Number.isNaN(current)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'current' expected number, got " + typeof current);

      return current + 1;
    })(level.value);
  }
  return encoder.encode(`${lines.value.join("\n")}
`);
}

  if (typeof op !== "string") throw new TypeError("add: arg 'op' expected string, got " + typeof op);

  if (typeof schema !== "string") throw new TypeError("add: arg 'schema' expected string, got " + typeof schema);

  if (typeof expected !== "string") throw new TypeError("add: arg 'expected' expected string, got " + typeof expected);

  if (typeof extra !== "object" || extra === null) throw new TypeError("add: arg 'extra' expected object, got " + typeof extra);

  const family = id.slice(0, 4);
