Explicit bound means inspector depth256/4096 visits and external RP01 budgets, plus package option only if an actual API is established; unsupported toJS/options must be recorded by Slice06.", "", "| ID | Phase here | Full owner | Operation / schema | Expected invariant or question |", "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |"] };
  for (const row of variants.value) {
    lines.value = appendItem(lines.value, `| ${row.id} | ${row.phase} | ${row.owner} | ${row.family === "HP" ? row.op : `${row.case.op} / ${row.case.options.schema}`} | ${row.expected} |`);
  }
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("case-manifest.md", `${lines.value.join("\n")}
`);
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ phase: "freeze", variants: variants.value["length"], sentinels: variants.value.filter(row => {
    if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

    return row.phase === "sentinel";
  })["length"] }));
}
const mode = Deno.args[0];
if (mode === "freeze") await freeze();

if (!["freeze", "audit", "graph"].includes(mode)) throw new Error("Unknown audit mode");

function records(path) {
  if (typeof path !== "string") throw new TypeError("records: arg 'path' expected string, got " + typeof path);

  return Deno.readTextFileSync(path).trim().split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.length > 0;
  }).map(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return JSON.parse(line);
  });
}
function facts(row) {
  if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("facts: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

  return new Map(row.stdout.trim().split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.length > 0;
  }).map(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return JSON.parse(line);
  }));
}
function entry(node, key) {
  if (typeof node !== "object" || node === null) throw new TypeError("entry: arg 'node' expected object, got " + typeof node);

  if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("entry: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

  const pair = node.entries.find(item => {
    if (!Array.isArray(item)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'item' expected array, got " + typeof item);

    const name = item[0];
    return name.value === key;
  });
  ensure(!(pair === undefined), `missing represented property ${key}`);
  return pair[1];
}
function equalFiles(a, b) {
  if (!Array.isArray(a)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'a' expected array, got " + typeof a);

  if (!Array.isArray(b)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'b' expected array, got " + typeof b);

  return JSON.stringify(a.toSorted((x, y) => {
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  })) === JSON.stringify(b.toSorted((x, y) => {
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  }));
}
function graphCheck() {
  const graph = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("dependency-graph.json"));
  const npmKeys = Object.keys(graph.npmPackages ?? {});
  ensure(npmKeys.length === 0, "npm graph");
  for (const module of graph.modules) {
    ensure(!(module.specifier.startsWith("npm:") || module.specifier.startsWith("node:")), "Node/npm module");
    ensure(!Object.hasOwn(module, "error"), "graph resolution error");
  }
  const lock = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("deno.lock"));
  ensure(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(lock.jsr)) === "[\"@std/yaml@1.2.0\"]", "one pinned package");
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ graph: "pass", modules: graph.modules.length, packages: Object.keys(lock.jsr) }));
}
async function audit() {
  graphCheck();
  const manifest = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("inputs.json"));
  const ids = new Set();
  const families = new Set();
  for (const spec of manifest.variants) {
    ensure(!ids.has(spec.id), "duplicate ID");
    ids.add(spec.id);
    if (!(spec.family === "HP")) {
      families.add(spec.family);
      const bytes = spec.inputKind === "recipe" ? recipeBytes(spec.case.recipe) : unhex(spec.case.hex);
      ensure(spec.inputSha256 === await digest(bytes), `${spec.id} original hash`);
      ensure(spec.encodedBytes === bytes.length, `${spec.id} original length`);
      ensure(spec.args[0] === JSON.stringify(spec.case), "exact case argv");
    }
  }
  ensure(families.size === 16, "all16 YAML families");
  ensure(manifest.variants.filter(v => {
    if (typeof v !== "object" || v === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'v' expected object, got " + typeof v);

    return v.family === "Y-02";
  })["length"] === 110, "scalar cross product");
  ensure(manifest.variants.filter(v => {
    if (typeof v !== "object" || v === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'v' expected object, got " + typeof v);

    return v.family === "Y-03";
  })["length"] === 50, "tag cross product");
  const specs = manifest.variants.filter(v => {
    if (typeof v !== "object" || v === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'v' expected object, got " + typeof v);

    return v.phase === "sentinel";
  });
  const runs = records("sentinel.stdout");
  ensure(runs.length === specs.length * 2, "all sentinel repeats");
  const sourceHash = await digest(Deno.readFileSync("cases.lykn"));
  const compiledHash = await digest(Deno.readFileSync("cases.js"));
  const lockHash = await digest(Deno.readFileSync("deno.lock"));
  const first = new Map();
  for (const spec of specs) {
    const pair = runs.filter(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.id === spec.id;
    });
    ensure(pair.length === 2, `${spec.id} count`);
    ensure(JSON.stringify(pair.map(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.attempt;
    })) === "[1,2]", "attempt identities");
    first.set(spec.id, pair[0]);
    if ((spec.expectedExit ?? 0) === 0) ensure(pair[0]["stdout"] === pair[1]["stdout"], `${spec.id} deterministic stdout`);

  }
  for (const row of runs) {
    const spec = specs.find(spec => {
      if (typeof spec !== "object" || spec === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'spec' expected object, got " + typeof spec);

      return spec.id === row.id;
    });
    ensure(row.exit === (spec.expectedExit ?? 0), `${row.id} exit`);
    ensure(row.stopReason === null, "no sentinel cap");
    ensure(row.survivors.length === 0, "no survivors");
    ensure(row.sourceSha256 === sourceHash, "source pin");
    ensure(row.compiledSha256 === compiledHash, "compiled pin");
    ensure(await digest(Deno.readFileSync(`${row.cwd}/deno.lock`)) === lockHash, "frozen attempt lock");
    ensure(row.stdoutSha256 === await digest(unhex(row.stdoutHex)), "stdout hash");
    ensure(row.stderrSha256 === await digest(unhex(row.stderrHex)), "stderr hash");
    ensure(equalFiles(row.inputState, row.inputAfter), "source immutable");
    if (!(row.id === "Y-01-edit")) ensure(equalFiles(row.outputBefore, row.outputAfter), "non-file probe leaves outputs unchanged");

    for (const file of row.outputAfter) {
      ensure(file.sha256 === await digest(unhex(file.hex)), "output file hash");
    }
  }
  function fact(id, label) {
    if (typeof id !== "string") throw new TypeError("fact: arg 'id' expected string, got " + typeof id);

    if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("fact: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

    const data = facts(first.get(id));
    return data.get(label);
  }
  for (const id of ["Y-04-duplicate-reject", "Y-06-unresolved", "Y-08-two-parse", "Y-09-malformed"]) {
    const error = fact(id, "error");
    ensure(error.name === "YamlSyntaxError", `${id} expected syntax error`);
    ensure(error.stage === "parse", "error stage");
    ensure(entry(error.details, "line")["kind"] === "number", "structured error line");
  }
  for (const schema of ["default", "core", "failsafe"]) {
    for (const style of ["plain", "quoted"]) {
      const node = entry(fact(`Y-02-true-${style}-${schema}`, "parsed"), "v");
      ensure(node.kind === (style === "quoted" || schema === "failsafe" ? "string" : "boolean"), "schema scalar kind");
      ensure(node.value === "true", "true scalar represented value");
    }
  }
  ensure(fact("Y-05-alias", "aliasBefore") === true, "alias identity");
  const aliasAfter = fact("Y-05-alias", "aliasAfter");
  ensure(aliasAfter.same && aliasAfter.bX === 9, "alias edit shared");
  ensure(fact("Y-06-cycle", "selfCycle") === true, "cycle identity");
  const cycleArray = entry(fact("Y-06-cycle", "parsed"), "a");
  ensure(entry(cycleArray, "0")["id"] === cycleArray.id, "cycle reference same traversal ID");
  ensure(fact("Y-08-two-parseAll", "parsed")["length"] === 2, "two documents");
  const edited = fact("Y-01-edit", "reread");
  ensure(entry(edited, "n")["value"] === "2", "reread n=2");
  ensure(entry(edited, "name")["value"] === "Ada", "reread name");
  ensure(entry(edited, "nil")["kind"] === "null", "reread null");
  const flags = entry(edited, "flags");
  ensure(entry(flags, "0")["value"] === "true", "reread first flag");
  ensure(entry(flags, "1")["value"] === "false", "reread second flag");
  const byteReport = { value: ["# Sentinel byte audit", "", "Generated by audit.lykn; zero-based positional differing ranges [start,end), including unmatched EOF bytes. Alignment is positional, not a minimum edit script. Original/noop/edit are separate byte records."] };
  for (const id of ["Y-01-edit", "Y-10-noop", "Y-10-edit"]) {
    const spec = specs.find(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.id === id;
    });
    const input = unhex(spec.case.hex);
    for (const label of ["noop", "output"]) {
      const output = unhex(fact(id, label)["hex"]);
      const ranges = { value: [] };
      const start = { value: null };
      for (const i of Array.from({ length: Math.max(input.length, output.length) }, (ignored, i) => {
        if (typeof i !== "number" || Number.isNaN(i)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'i' expected number, got " + typeof i);

        return i;
      })) {
        const different = !(input[i] === output[i]);
        if (different && start.value === null) start.value = i;

        if (!different && !(start.value === null)) {
          ranges.value = appendItem(ranges.value, [start.value, i]);
          start.value = null;
        }
      }
      if (!(start.value === null)) ranges.value = appendItem(ranges.value, [start.value, Math.max(input.length, output.length)]);

      byteReport.value = appendItem(byteReport.value, `
## ${id} ${label}

Original ${input.length} bytes SHA256 ${await digest(input)} hex ${hex(input)}

Observed ${output.length} bytes SHA256 ${await digest(output)} hex ${hex(output)}

Differing ranges ${JSON.stringify(ranges.value)}
`);
    }
  }
  const controls = records("controls.stdout");
  ensure(controls.length === 3, "three supervisor controls");
  for (const row of controls) {
    ensure(row.stopReason === (row.id === "control-timeout" ? "wall" : row.id === "control-output" ? "output" : "rss"), "control reason");
    ensure(row.exit === 137, "control exit");
    ensure(row.survivors.length === 0, "control cleanup");
    ensure(row.maxSampledTreeRssKiB > 0, "control observation");
    if (row.id === "control-output") ensure(row.outputBytesRetained <= 4096, "combined output bound");

  }
  const inspected = fact("HP-inspector-control", "inspector");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "0")["kind"] === "undefined", "undefined tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "1")["kind"] === "null", "null tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "3")["value"] === "-0", "negative zero tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "4")["value"] === "NaN", "NaN tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "5")["value"] === "Infinity", "Infinity tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "6")["kind"] === "date", "timestamp tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "7")["hex"] === "00ff", "binary exact");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "8")["kind"] === "map", "map keys represented separately");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "9")["kind"] === "set", "set inspected");
  ensure(fact("HP-inspector-control", "bounds")["truncated"] === true, "string bound");
  ensure(JSON.stringify(fact("HP-inspector-control", "depthBound")).includes("depth-bound"), "depth bound");
  const mapNode = entry(inspected, "8");
  ensure(mapNode.entries[0][0]["kind"] === "boolean", "map boolean key");
  ensure(mapNode.entries[1][0]["kind"] === "number", "map numeric key");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "6")["iso"] === "2026-09-12T00:00:00.000Z", "timestamp value");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "12")["kind"] === "function", "unsupported function tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "13")["length"] === 2, "sparse length");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "13")["entries"]["length"] === 0, "sparse absent own slots");
  ensure(first.get("HP-unknown-case")["stderr"].includes("Unknown case ID: NOT-A-CASE"), "unknown ID explicit");
  ensure(first.get("HP-unknown-operation")["stderr"].includes("Unknown operation:"), "unknown operation explicit");
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("byte-audit.md", `${byteReport.value.join("\n")}
`);
  const report = { value: ["# Sentinel observations", "", "Generated by retained Lykn audit; first of two deterministic attempts shown. These are preparation probes, not completed YAML families."] };
  for (const spec of specs) {
    const row = first.get(spec.id);
    report.value = appendItem(report.value, `
## ${spec.id}

Exit ${row.exit}; stop reason ${row.stopReason}; two attempts.
`);
    if (!(spec.family === "HP")) report.value = appendItem(report.value, `
\`\`\`json
${row.stdout}\`\`\`
`);

  }
  report.value = appendItem(report.value, "\n## Frozen family ownership and counts\n\n| Family | Variants | Owner |\n| --- | --- | --- |");
  for (const family of Array.from(families).sort()) {
    const owned = manifest.variants.filter(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.family === family;
    });
    report.value = appendItem(report.value, `| ${family} | ${owned.length} | ${owned[0]["owner"]} |`);
  }
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("sentinel-summary.md", `${report.value.join("\n")}
`);
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ result: "pass", checks: checks.value, sentinelAttempts: runs.length, frozenVariants: manifest.variants.length, yamlFamilies: families.size }));
}
if (mode === "graph") graphCheck();

if (mode === "audit") await audit();


END FILE

#!/bin/bash
set -u
yaml_source=$(cat /private/tmp/lykn-yaml-source-path)
yaml_trial=$(cat /private/tmp/lykn-yaml-trial-path)
yaml_label=$1
shift
cd "$yaml_trial"
printf 'command: ' > "$yaml_label.command"
printf '%q ' "$@" >> "$yaml_label.command"
printf '\nCWD=%s\nPATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin\nHOME=%s/home\nTMPDIR=%s/tmp\nDENO_DIR=%s/cache\nDENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1\nNO_COLOR=1\n' "$yaml_trial" "$yaml_trial" "$yaml_trial" "$yaml_trial" >> "$yaml_label.command"
date -u '+start=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >> "$yaml_label.command"
env -i PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$yaml_trial/home" TMPDIR="$yaml_trial/tmp" DENO_DIR="$yaml_trial/cache" DENO_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 NO_COLOR=1 "$@" < /dev/null > "$yaml_label.stdout" 2> "$yaml_label.stderr"
yaml_rc=$?
printf 'exit=%s\n' "$yaml_rc" >> "$yaml_label.command"
date -u '+end=%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' >> "$yaml_label.command"
printf '%s exit=%s\n' "$yaml_label" "$yaml_rc"
exit "$yaml_rc"

END FILE

// This module is browser compatible.

/**
 * {@linkcode parse} and {@linkcode stringify} for handling
 * {@link https://yaml.org/ | YAML} encoded data.
 *
 * Ported from
 * {@link https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/commit/665aadda42349dcae869f12040d9b10ef18d12da | js-yaml v3.13.1}.
 *
 * Use {@linkcode parseAll} for parsing multiple documents in a single YAML
 * string.
 *
 * This package generally supports
 * {@link https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/ | YAML 1.2.x} (latest) and some
 * {@link https://yaml.org/spec/1.1/current.html | YAML 1.1} features that are
 * commonly used in the wild.
 *
 * Supported YAML 1.1 features include:
 * - {@link https://yaml.org/type/merge.html | Merge} type (`<<` symbol)
 *
 * Unsupported YAML 1.1 features include:
 * - Yes, No, On, Off literals for bool type
 * - Sexagesimal numbers (e.g. `3:25:45`)
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { parse, stringify } from "@std/yaml";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const data = parse(`
 * foo: bar
 * baz:
 *   - qux
 *   - quux
 * `);
 * assertEquals(data, { foo: "bar", baz: [ "qux", "quux" ] });
 *
 * const yaml = stringify({ foo: "bar", baz: ["qux", "quux"] });
 * assertEquals(yaml, `foo: bar
 * baz:
 *   - qux
 *   - quux
 * `);
 * ```
 *
 * ## Limitations
 * - `binary` type is currently not stable.
 *
 * @module
 */

export * from "./parse.ts";
export * from "./stringify.ts";
export * from "./types.ts";

// Ported from js-yaml v3.13.1:

import { isEOL } from "./_chars.ts";
import { LoaderState } from "./_loader_state.ts";
import { SCHEMA_MAP, type SchemaType } from "./_schema.ts";
import type { YamlSyntaxError } from "./types.ts";

export type { SchemaType };

/** Options for {@linkcode parse}. */
export interface ParseOptions {
  /**
   * Name of the schema to use.
   *
   * @default {"default"}
   */
  schema?: SchemaType;
  /**
   * If `true`, duplicate keys will overwrite previous values. Otherwise,
   * duplicate keys will throw a {@linkcode YamlSyntaxError}.
   *
   * @default {false}
   */
  allowDuplicateKeys?: boolean;
  /**
   * If defined, a function to call on warning messages taking a
   * {@linkcode YamlSyntaxError} as its only argument.
   */
  onWarning?(error: YamlSyntaxError): void;
}

function sanitizeInput(input: string) {
  input = String(input);

  if (input.length > 0) {
    // Add trailing `\n` if not exists
    if (!isEOL(input.charCodeAt(input.length - 1))) input += "\n";

    // Strip BOM
    if (input.charCodeAt(0) === 0xfeff) input = input.slice(1);
  }

  return input;
}

/**
 * Parse and return a YAML string as a parsed YAML document object.
 *
 * Note: This does not support functions. Untrusted data is safe to parse.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { parse } from "@std/yaml/parse";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const data = parse(`
 * id: 1
 * name: Alice
 * `);
 *
 * assertEquals(data, { id: 1, name: "Alice" });
 * ```
 *
 * @throws {YamlSyntaxError} Throws if the YAML is invalid or contains more
 * than one document.
 * @param content YAML string to parse.
 * @param options Parsing options.
 * @returns Parsed document.
 */
export function parse(
  content: string,
  options: ParseOptions = {},
): unknown {
  content = sanitizeInput(content);
  const state = new LoaderState(content, {
    ...options,
    schema: SCHEMA_MAP.get(options.schema!)!,
  });
  const documents = state.readDocuments({ singleDocument: true });
  const document = documents.next().value;
  documents.next();
  return document ?? null;
}

/**
 * Same as {@linkcode parse}, but understands multi-document YAML sources, and
 * returns multiple parsed YAML document objects.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { parseAll } from "@std/yaml/parse";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const data = parseAll(`
 * ---
 * id: 1
 * name: Alice
 * ---
 * id: 2
 * name: Bob
 * ---
 * id: 3
 * name: Eve
 * `);
 * assertEquals(data, [ { id: 1, name: "Alice" }, { id: 2, name: "Bob" }, { id: 3, name: "Eve" }]);
 * ```
 *
 * @throws {YamlSyntaxError} Throws if the YAML is invalid.
 * @param content YAML string to parse.
 * @param options Parsing options.
 * @returns Array of parsed documents.
 */
export function parseAll(
  content: string,
  options: ParseOptions = {},
): unknown[] {
  content = sanitizeInput(content);
  const state = new LoaderState(content, {
    ...options,
    schema: SCHEMA_MAP.get(options.schema!)!,
  });
  return [...state.readDocuments()];
}

END FILE

// Ported from js-yaml v3.13.1:
// https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/commit/665aadda42349dcae869f12040d9b10ef18d12da

import type { KindType, Type } from "./_type.ts";
import { binary } from "./_type/binary.ts";
import { bool } from "./_type/bool.ts";
import { float } from "./_type/float.ts";
import { int } from "./_type/int.ts";
import { map } from "./_type/map.ts";
import { merge } from "./_type/merge.ts";
import { nil } from "./_type/nil.ts";
import { omap } from "./_type/omap.ts";
import { pairs } from "./_type/pairs.ts";
import { regexp } from "./_type/regexp.ts";
import { seq } from "./_type/seq.ts";
import { set } from "./_type/set.ts";
import { str } from "./_type/str.ts";
import { timestamp } from "./_type/timestamp.ts";
import { undefinedType } from "./_type/undefined.ts";

/**
 * Name of the schema to use.
 *
 * > [!NOTE]
 * > It is recommended to use the schema that is most appropriate for your use
 * > case. Doing so will avoid any unnecessary processing and benefit
 * > performance.
 *
 * Options include:
 * - `failsafe`: supports generic mappings, generic sequences and generic
 * strings.
 * - `json`: extends `failsafe` schema by also supporting nulls, booleans,
 * integers and floats.
 * - `core`: functionally the same as `json` schema.
 * - `default`: extends `core` schema by also supporting binary, omap, pairs and
 * set types.
 * - `extended`: extends `default` schema by also supporting regular
 * expressions and undefined values.
 *
 * See
 * {@link https://yaml.org/spec/1.2.2/#chapter-10-recommended-schemas | YAML 1.2 spec}
 * for more details on the `failsafe`, `json` and `core` schemas.
 */
export type SchemaType = "failsafe" | "json" | "core" | "default" | "extended";

/**
 * A type that can be implicitly resolved (i.e. without using a tag) when
 * loading a YAML document.
 */
export type ImplicitType = Type<"scalar">;
export type ExplicitType = Type<KindType>;

export type TypeMap = Record<
  KindType | "fallback",
  Map<string, ExplicitType>
>;

function createTypeMap(
  implicitTypes: ImplicitType[],
  explicitTypes: ExplicitType[],
): TypeMap {
  const result: TypeMap = {
    fallback: new Map(),
    mapping: new Map(),
    scalar: new Map(),
    sequence: new Map(),
  };
  const fallbackMap = result.fallback;
  for (const type of [...implicitTypes, ...explicitTypes]) {
    const map = result[type.kind];
    map.set(type.tag, type);
    fallbackMap.set(type.tag, type);
  }
  return result;
}

export interface Schema {
  implicitTypes: ImplicitType[];
  explicitTypes: ExplicitType[];
  typeMap: TypeMap;
}

function createSchema({ explicitTypes = [], implicitTypes = [], include }: {
  implicitTypes?: ImplicitType[];
  explicitTypes?: ExplicitType[];
  include?: Schema;
}): Schema {
  if (include) {
    implicitTypes.push(...include.implicitTypes);
    explicitTypes.push(...include.explicitTypes);
  }
  const typeMap = createTypeMap(implicitTypes, explicitTypes);
  return { implicitTypes, explicitTypes, typeMap };
}

/**
 * Standard YAML's failsafe schema.
 *
 * @see {@link http://www.yaml.org/spec/1.2/spec.html#id2802346}
 */
const FAILSAFE_SCHEMA = createSchema({
  explicitTypes: [str, seq, map],
});

/**
 * Standard YAML's JSON schema.
 *
 * @see {@link http://www.yaml.org/spec/1.2/spec.html#id2803231}
 */
const JSON_SCHEMA = createSchema({
  implicitTypes: [nil, bool, int, float],
  include: FAILSAFE_SCHEMA,
});

/**
 * Standard YAML's core schema.
 *
 * @see {@link http://www.yaml.org/spec/1.2/spec.html#id2804923}
 */
const CORE_SCHEMA = createSchema({
  include: JSON_SCHEMA,
});

/**
 * Default YAML schema. It is not described in the YAML specification.
 */
export const DEFAULT_SCHEMA = createSchema({
  explicitTypes: [binary, omap, pairs, set],
  implicitTypes: [timestamp, merge],
  include: CORE_SCHEMA,
});

/***
 * Extends JS-YAML default schema with additional JavaScript types
 * It is not described in the YAML specification.
 * Functions are no longer supported for security reasons.
 *
 * @example
 * ```ts
 * import { parse } from "@std/yaml";
 *
 * const data = parse(
 *   `
 *   regexp:
 *     simple: !!js/regexp foobar
 *     modifiers: !!js/regexp /foobar/mi
 *   undefined: !!js/undefined ~
 * `,
 *   { schema: "extended" },
 * );
 * ```
 */
const EXTENDED_SCHEMA = createSchema({
  explicitTypes: [regexp, undefinedType],
  include: DEFAULT_SCHEMA,
});

export const SCHEMA_MAP = new Map<SchemaType, Schema>([
  ["core", CORE_SCHEMA],
  ["default", DEFAULT_SCHEMA],
  ["failsafe", FAILSAFE_SCHEMA],
  ["json", JSON_SCHEMA],
  ["extended", EXTENDED_SCHEMA],
]);

export function getSchema(
  schema: SchemaType = "default",
  types?: ImplicitType[],
): Schema {
  const schemaObj = SCHEMA_MAP.get(schema)!;

  if (!types) {
    return schemaObj;
  }

  return createSchema({
    implicitTypes: [...types, ...schemaObj.implicitTypes],
    explicitTypes: [...schemaObj.explicitTypes],
  });
}

END FILE

import { DumperState } from "./_dumper_state.ts";
import { SCHEMA_MAP, type SchemaType } from "./_schema.ts";

export type { SchemaType, StyleVariant };

/** Options for {@linkcode stringify}. */
export type StringifyOptions = {
  /**
   * Indentation width to use (in spaces).
   *
   * @default {2}
   */
  indent?: number;
  /**
   * When true, adds an indentation level to array elements.
   *
   * @default {true}
   */
  arrayIndent?: boolean;
  /**
   * Do not throw on invalid types (like function in the safe schema) and skip
   * pairs and single values with such types.
   *
   * @default {false}
   */
  skipInvalid?: boolean;
  /**
   * Specifies level of nesting, when to switch from block to flow style for
   * collections. `-1` means block style everywhere.
   *
   * @default {-1}
   */
  flowLevel?: number;
  /** Each tag may have own set of styles.	- "tag" => "style" map. */
  styles?: Record<string, StyleVariant>;
  /**
   * Name of the schema to use.
   *
   * @default {"default"}
   */
  schema?: SchemaType;
  /**
   * If true, sort keys when dumping YAML in ascending, ASCII character order.
   * If a function, use the function to sort the keys.
   * If a function is specified, the function must return a negative value
   * if first argument is less than second argument, zero if they're equal
   * and a positive value otherwise.
   *
   * @default {false}
   */
  sortKeys?: boolean | ((a: string, b: string, depth: number) => number);
  /**
   * Set max line width.
   *
   * @default {80}
   */
  lineWidth?: number;
  /**
   * If false, don't convert duplicate objects into references.
   *
   * @default {true}
   */
  useAnchors?: boolean;
  /**
   * If false don't try to be compatible with older yaml versions.
   * Currently: don't quote "yes", "no" and so on,
   * as required for YAML 1.1.
   *
   * @default {true}
   */
  compatMode?: boolean;
  /**
   * If true flow sequences will be condensed, omitting the
   * space between `key: value` or `a, b`. Eg. `'[a,b]'` or `{a:{b:c}}`.
   * Can be useful when using yaml for pretty URL query params
   * as spaces are %-encoded.
   *
   * @default {false}
   */
  condenseFlow?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Converts a JavaScript object or value to a YAML document string.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { stringify } from "@std/yaml/stringify";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const data = { id: 1, name: "Alice" };
 * const yaml = stringify(data);
 *
 * assertEquals(yaml, "id: 1\nname: Alice\n");
 * ```
 *
 * @throws {TypeError} If `data` contains invalid types.
 * @param data The data to serialize.
 * @param options The options for serialization.
 * @returns A YAML string.
 */
export function stringify(
  data: unknown,
  options: StringifyOptions = {},
): string {
  const state = new DumperState({
    ...options,
    schema: SCHEMA_MAP.get(options.schema!)!,
  });
  return state.stringify(data);
}

f1b0fbc028b062e69f3e1b56de1058d7c2f0aa424c29777d506861e86b664c50  /private/tmp/lykn-p07-yaml-trial.vw3Kjl/meta/types.ts
// Copyright 2018-2026 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.

/**
 * Type definitions for the YAML parser.
 *
 * @module
 */

/**
 * Position information for error reporting.
 *
 * `line` and `column` are 1-indexed; `offset` is the 0-indexed character
 * offset into the source string.
 */
export interface YamlPosition {
  /** Line number (1-indexed). */
  readonly line: number;
  /** Column number (1-indexed). */
  readonly column: number;
  /** Character offset in the input (0-indexed). */
  readonly offset: number;
}

/**
 * Error thrown when YAML parsing fails.
 *
 * Subclass of {@linkcode SyntaxError}, so existing
 * `instanceof SyntaxError` checks keep working. Carries structured
 * position information so consumers do not have to parse the message.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { parse, YamlSyntaxError } from "@std/yaml";
 * import { assertInstanceOf } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * try {
 *   parse(`"`);
 * } catch (error) {
 *   assertInstanceOf(error, YamlSyntaxError);
 *   assertInstanceOf(error, SyntaxError);
 * }
 * ```
 */
export class YamlSyntaxError extends SyntaxError {
  /**
   * The line number where the error occurred (1-indexed).
   *
   * @example Usage
   * ```ts
   * import { YamlSyntaxError } from "@std/yaml";
   * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
   *
   * const error = new YamlSyntaxError("Test", { line: 5, column: 10, offset: 50 });
   * assertEquals(error.line, 5);
   * ```
   */
  readonly line: number;
  /**
   * The column number where the error occurred (1-indexed).
   *
   * @example Usage
   * ```ts
   * import { YamlSyntaxError } from "@std/yaml";
   * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
   *
   * const error = new YamlSyntaxError("Test", { line: 5, column: 10, offset: 50 });
   * assertEquals(error.column, 10);
   * ```
   */
  readonly column: number;
  /**
   * The character offset where the error occurred (0-indexed).
   *
   * @example Usage
   * ```ts
   * import { YamlSyntaxError } from "@std/yaml";
   * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
   *
   * const error = new YamlSyntaxError("Test", { line: 5, column: 10, offset: 50 });
   * assertEquals(error.offset, 50);
   * ```
   */
  readonly offset: number;
  /**
   * A formatted snippet of the source around the error, including a caret
   * line indicating the column. Undefined when the source is empty.
   *
   * @example Usage
   * ```ts
   * import { YamlSyntaxError } from "@std/yaml";
   * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
   *
   * const snippet = "    foo: bar\n         ^";
   * const error = new YamlSyntaxError(
   *   "Test",
   *   { line: 1, column: 6, offset: 5 },
   *   snippet,
   * );
   * assertEquals(error.snippet, snippet);
   * ```
   */
  readonly snippet?: string;

  /**
   * Constructs a new YamlSyntaxError.
   *
   * The constructed `message` is `${message} at line ${line}, column ${column}`,
   * with `:\n${snippet}` appended when a snippet is provided.
   *
   * @param message The error message describing the syntax issue.
   * @param position The position in the YAML source where the error occurred.
   * @param snippet Optional formatted snippet of the source around the error.
   */
  constructor(message: string, position: YamlPosition, snippet?: string) {
    let fullMessage =
      `${message} at line ${position.line}, column ${position.column}`;
    if (snippet) fullMessage += `:\n${snippet}`;
    super(fullMessage);
    this.name = "YamlSyntaxError";
    this.line = position.line;
    this.column = position.column;
    this.offset = position.offset;
    if (snippet !== undefined) this.snippet = snippet;
  }
}

  (add "Y-05-alias" "a: &base {x: 1}\nb: *base\n" "alias" "default" "Report a===b before edit and b.x after a.x=9" (obj))
  (add "Y-06-cycle" "a: &a [*a]\n" "cycle" "default" "Inspector terminates and reports repeated identity; parser outcome characterized" (obj))
  (add "Y-06-unresolved" "a: *missing\n" "parse" "default" "Unresolved alias rejected with positioned error" (obj))
  (for-of schema schemas
    (add (template "Y-07-merge-" schema) "base: &b {x: 1, y: 2}\nitem: {<<: *b, y: 3}\n" "rewrite" schema
      "Characterize merge resolution, overrides and loss/retention of merge/anchor presentation" (obj)))
  (bind document-inputs #a("---\na: 1\n...\n---\nb: 2\n" "---\na: 1\n---\n---\nb: 2\n" "---\na: 1\n---\nb: [\n"))
  (for-of pair (document-inputs:entries)
    (for-of op #a("parse" "parseAll")
      (bind label (get #a("two" "empty" "invalid") (get pair 0)))
      (add (template "Y-08-" label "-" op) (get pair 1) op "default"
        "Single parse rejects multiple docs; parseAll preserves order/empty docs or returns attributable error; no false all-success" (obj))))
  (bind malformed-inputs #a("a: [1,\n" "a:\n  b: 1\n c: 2\n" "a: &x 1\nb: &x 2\nc: *x\n" "a:\n\tb: 1\n"))
  (for-of pair (malformed-inputs:entries)
    (add (template "Y-09-" (get #a("malformed" "indent" "anchor" "tab") (get pair 0))) (get pair 1) "parse" "default"
      "Record errors/warnings with exact positions; duplicate-anchor outcome unknown; rejected parse must not replace destination" (obj)))
  (for-of edit #a("none" "n=2")
    (add (template "Y-10-" (? (= edit "none") "noop" "edit")) presentation "rewrite" "default"
      "Retain original/noop/edited bytes; presentation loss characterized independently of semantic edit" (obj :edit edit)))
  (bind presentations #a("text: |+\n  one\n\n" "text: >-\n  one\n  two\n" "%YAML 1.2\n---\nn: 1\n"
    "\uFEFFn: 1\n" "n: 1\r\ntext: hello\r\n" "n: 1"))
  (for-of pair (presentations:entries)
    (add (template "Y-11-" (get #a("literal" "folded" "directive" "bom" "crlf" "no-lf") (get pair 0)))
      (get pair 1) "rewrite" "default" "Scalar semantic newlines and document presentation are separate; retain all byte changes" (obj)))
  (for-of token #a("9007199254740991" "9007199254740992" "9007199254740993" "-9007199254740993" "0.1" "1.2300" "1e400" "1e-400" "-0")
    (for-of schema schemas
      (add (template "Y-12-number-" token "-" schema) (template "x: " token "\n") "parse" schema
        "Original numeric token retained; represented Number loss cannot be hidden by roundtrip" (obj))))
  (bind presence-inputs #a("{}\n" "x: null\n" "x: false\n" "x: 0\n" "x: \"\"\n"))
  (for-of pair (presence-inputs:entries)
    (add (template "Y-12-presence-" (get pair 0)) (get pair 1) "parse" "default"
      "Distinguish own presence/null/falsy and preserve false/zero/empty defaults" (obj)))
  (add "Y-12-own-undefined" "{}\n" "runtime-presence" "extended" "Construct own x=undefined, distinguish absence and report serializer effect" (obj))
  (add "Y-12-exact-keys" "first-name: 0\nfirstName: 1\n\"\": 2\n\"a:b\": 3\na/b: 4\n\"~\": 5\n__proto__: 6\nconstructor: 7\ntoString: 8\n"
    "keys" "default" "Exact dynamic keys, own properties and prototype unchanged after value edit" (obj :edit "add10 to every value"))
  (for-of kind #a("depth" "string" "alias-dag")
    (bind sizes (? (= kind "depth") #a(16 64 256) (? (= kind "string") #a(1024 1048576 8388608) #a(4 8 12))))
    (for-of size sizes
      (for-of bound #a("default" "explicit")
        (for-of operation #a("parse" "toJS" "stringify")
          (add (template "Y-13-" kind "-" size "-" bound "-" operation) "" "resource" "default"
            "One warmup+5; supervisor10s/16MiB/512MiB sampled; stop larger family on cap; absent API/bound is unsupported, not silently simulated"
            (obj :recipe (obj :kind kind :size size :fanout 2 :bound bound :operation operation)
              :encodedLimit 9437184 :payloadLimit 8388608))))))
  (for-of pair (-> #a(presentation) (:concat presentations) (:entries))
    (for-of tokens #a(false true)
      (for-of edit #a("none" "n=2")
        (add (template "Y-14-doc" (get pair 0) "-tokens" tokens "-" edit) (get pair 1) "document" "default"
          "GATED: Document.setIn/toString, node comments and keepSourceTokens comparison; preserve semantic intent and every unrelated byte change"
          (obj :keepSourceTokens tokens :edit edit)))))
  (for-of kind #a("Date" "Map" "Set" "undefined" "function" "cycle")
    (for-of skip #a(false true)
      (add (template "Y-15-" kind "-skip" skip) "" "runtime" "default"
        "Characterize accepted/rejected/coerced/dropped; skipInvalid never means fidelity" (obj :runtimeKind kind :stringifyOptions (obj :schema "default" :skipInvalid skip)))))
  (for-of mode #a("missing" "unreadable" "missing-parent" "unwritable" "raw-interrupt" "safe-interrupt" "rename-injected" "rename-directory")
    (add (template "Y-16-" mode) base "file-failure" "default"
      "Preserve source and safe destination on failure; raw truncation separate; modes/path failures versus injected failure explicit"
      (obj :failure mode :edit "n=2")))
  (for-of row (express variants)
    (bind bytes (? (= row:family "Y-13") (recipe-bytes row:case:recipe) (unhex row:case:hex)))
    (Object:define-property row "inputSha256" (obj :value (await (digest bytes)) :enumerable true))
    (Object:define-property row "encodedBytes" (obj :value bytes:length :enumerable true))
    (Object:define-property row "inputKind" (obj :value (? (= row:family "Y-13") "recipe" "literal") :enumerable true)))
  (for-of control #a("inspector-control" "unknown-operation" "unknown-case")
    (swap! variants append-item (obj :id (template "HP-" control) :family "HP" :owner "slice03-yaml-preflight"
      :phase "sentinel" :op (? (= control "unknown-case") "probe" control)
      :args (? (= control "unknown-case") #a("{\"id\":\"NOT-A-CASE\"}") #a()) :repeats 2 :flags #a() :files #a()
      :expectedExit (? (= control "inspector-control") 0 1) :expected "Inspector exact kinds/bounds or explicit rejection of unknown operation/case")))
  (bind manifest (obj :protocol "RP01/FM01" :revision "YP-M01" :schemas schemas
    :sentinelPurpose "Preparation controls only; full families remain owed" :variants (express variants)))
  (Deno:write-text-file-sync "inputs.json" (template (JSON:stringify manifest null 2) "\n"))
  (bind lines (cell #a("# Frozen YAML matrix — YP-M01" "" "Generated by retained audit.lykn freeze before YAML execution. All YAML families remain owed to their listed full-execution owners. Literal UTF-8 bytes/hash, schema/options, repeats and expectation are in inputs.json; no parser-under-test oracle." "" "Y-02: eleven scalars × two quoting styles × five schemas. Empty unquoted uses v: with an empty value; quoted empty is a string. Y-03: ten tags × five schemas. Resource recipes are specified below, never executed here. Y-14 remains gated on D-2609-YNOD and Slice04 policy." "" "Resource bytes: depth=N open brackets + scalar0 + N closing brackets + LF; string=x repeated N as a plain scalar plus LF; alias DAG: base: &a0 [x,x], then aI: &aI [*a(I-1),*a(I-1)] for I=1..N. Explicit bound means inspector depth256/4096 visits and external RP01 budgets, plus package option only if an actual API is established; unsupported toJS/options must be recorded by Slice06." "" "| ID | Phase here | Full owner | Operation / schema | Expected invariant or question |" "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")))
  (for-of row (express variants)
    (swap! lines append-item (template "| " row:id " | " row:phase " | " row:owner " | "
      (? (= row:family "HP") row:op (template row:case:op " / " row:case:options:schema)) " | " row:expected " |")))
  (Deno:write-text-file-sync "case-manifest.md" (template (-> (express lines) (:join "\n")) "\n"))
  (console:log (JSON:stringify (obj :phase "freeze" :variants (get (express variants) "length")
    :sentinels (get (-> (express variants) (:filter (fn (:object row) (= row:phase "sentinel")))) "length"))))))
(bind mode (get Deno:args 0))
(if (= mode "freeze") (await (freeze)))
(if (not (-> #a("freeze" "audit" "graph" "planning") (:includes mode))) (throw (new Error "Unknown audit mode")))

(func records :args (:string path) :body
  (-> (Deno:read-text-file-sync path) (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0))) (:map (fn (:string line) (JSON:parse line)))))
(func facts :args (:object row) :body
  (new Map (-> row:stdout (:trim) (:split "\n")
    (:filter (fn (:string line) (> line:length 0))) (:map (fn (:string line) (JSON:parse line))))))
(func entry :args (:object node :string key) :body
  (bind pair (node:entries:find (fn (:array item) (bind name (get item 0)) (= name:value key))))
  (ensure (not (= pair undefined)) (template "missing represented property " key))
  (get pair 1))
(func equal-files :args (:array a :array b) :body
  (= (JSON:stringify (a:to-sorted (fn (:object x :object y) (x:path:locale-compare y:path))))
    (JSON:stringify (b:to-sorted (fn (:object x :object y) (x:path:locale-compare y:path))))))
(func graph-check :args () :body
  (bind graph (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "dependency-graph.json")))
  (bind npm-keys (Object:keys (?? graph:npmPackages (obj))))
  (ensure (= npm-keys:length 0) "npm graph")
  (for-of module graph:modules
    (ensure (not (or (module:specifier:starts-with "npm:") (module:specifier:starts-with "node:"))) "Node/npm module")
    (ensure (not (Object:has-own module "error")) "graph resolution error"))
  (bind lock (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "deno.lock")))
  (ensure (= (JSON:stringify (Object:keys lock:jsr)) "[\"@std/yaml@1.2.0\"]") "one pinned package")
  (console:log (JSON:stringify (obj :graph "pass" :modules graph:modules:length :packages (Object:keys lock:jsr)))))
(async (func audit :args () :body
  (graph-check)
  (bind manifest (JSON:parse (Deno:read-text-file-sync "inputs.json")))
  (bind ids (new Set))
  (bind families (new Set))
  (for-of spec manifest:variants
    (ensure (not (ids:has spec:id)) "duplicate ID") (ids:add spec:id)
    (if (not (= spec:family "HP"))
      (do (families:add spec:family)
          (bind bytes (? (= spec:inputKind "recipe") (recipe-bytes spec:case:recipe) (unhex spec:case:hex)))
          (ensure (= spec:inputSha256 (await (digest bytes))) (template spec:id " original hash"))
          (ensure (= spec:encodedBytes bytes:length) (template spec:id " original length"))
          (ensure (= (get spec:args 0) (JSON:stringify spec:case)) "exact case argv"))))
  (ensure (= families:size 16) "all16 YAML families")
  (ensure (= (get (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object v) (= v:family "Y-02"))) "length") 110) "scalar cross product")
  (ensure (= (get (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object v) (= v:family "Y-03"))) "length") 50) "tag cross product")
  (bind specs (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object v) (= v:phase "sentinel"))))
  (bind runs (records "sentinel.stdout"))
  (ensure (= runs:length (* specs:length 2)) "all sentinel repeats")
  (bind source-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "cases.lykn"))))
  (bind compiled-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "cases.js"))))
  (bind lock-hash (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync "deno.lock"))))
  (bind first (new Map))
  (for-of spec specs
    (bind pair (runs:filter (fn (:object row) (= row:id spec:id))))
    (ensure (= pair:length 2) (template spec:id " count"))
    (ensure (= (JSON:stringify (pair:map (fn (:object row) row:attempt))) "[1,2]") "attempt identities")
    (first:set spec:id (get pair 0))
    (if (= (?? spec:expectedExit 0) 0)
      (ensure (= (get (get pair 0) "stdout") (get (get pair 1) "stdout")) (template spec:id " deterministic stdout"))))
  (for-of row runs
    (bind spec (specs:find (fn (:object spec) (= spec:id row:id))))
    (ensure (= row:exit (?? spec:expectedExit 0)) (template row:id " exit"))
    (ensure (= row:stopReason null) "no sentinel cap")
    (ensure (= row:survivors:length 0) "no survivors")
    (ensure (= row:sourceSha256 source-hash) "source pin")
    (ensure (= row:compiledSha256 compiled-hash) "compiled pin")
    (ensure (= (await (digest (Deno:read-file-sync (template row:cwd "/deno.lock")))) lock-hash) "frozen attempt lock")
    (ensure (= row:stdoutSha256 (await (digest (unhex row:stdoutHex)))) "stdout hash")
    (ensure (= row:stderrSha256 (await (digest (unhex row:stderrHex)))) "stderr hash")
    (ensure (equal-files row:inputState row:inputAfter) "source immutable")
    (if (not (= row:id "Y-01-edit"))
      (ensure (equal-files row:outputBefore row:outputAfter) "non-file probe leaves outputs unchanged"))
    (for-of file row:outputAfter
      (ensure (= file:sha256 (await (digest (unhex file:hex)))) "output file hash")))
  (func fact :args (:string id :string label) :body (bind data (facts (first:get id))) (data:get label))
  (for-of id #a("Y-04-duplicate-reject" "Y-06-unresolved" "Y-08-two-parse" "Y-09-malformed")
    (bind error (fact id "error"))
    (ensure (= error:name "YamlSyntaxError") (template id " expected syntax error"))
    (ensure (= error:stage "parse") "error stage")
    (ensure (= (get (entry error:details "line") "kind") "number") "structured error line"))
  (for-of schema #a("default" "core" "failsafe")
    (for-of style #a("plain" "quoted")
      (bind node (entry (fact (template "Y-02-true-" style "-" schema) "parsed") "v"))
      (ensure (= node:kind (? (or (= style "quoted") (= schema "failsafe")) "string" "boolean")) "schema scalar kind")
      (ensure (= node:value "true") "true scalar represented value")))
  (ensure (= (fact "Y-05-alias" "aliasBefore") true) "alias identity")
  (bind alias-after (fact "Y-05-alias" "aliasAfter"))
  (ensure (and alias-after:same (= alias-after:bX 9)) "alias edit shared")
  (ensure (= (fact "Y-06-cycle" "selfCycle") true) "cycle identity")
  (bind cycle-array (entry (fact "Y-06-cycle" "parsed") "a"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry cycle-array "0") "id") cycle-array:id) "cycle reference same traversal ID")
  (ensure (= (get (fact "Y-08-two-parseAll" "parsed") "length") 2) "two documents")
  (bind edited (fact "Y-01-edit" "reread"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry edited "n") "value") "2") "reread n=2")
  (ensure (= (get (entry edited "name") "value") "Ada") "reread name")
  (ensure (= (get (entry edited "nil") "kind") "null") "reread null")
  (bind flags (entry edited "flags"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry flags "0") "value") "true") "reread first flag")
  (ensure (= (get (entry flags "1") "value") "false") "reread second flag")
  (bind byte-report (cell #a("# Sentinel byte audit" "" "Generated by audit.lykn; zero-based positional differing ranges [start,end), including unmatched EOF bytes. Alignment is positional, not a minimum edit script. Original/noop/edit are separate byte records.")))
  (for-of id #a("Y-01-edit" "Y-10-noop" "Y-10-edit")
    (bind spec (specs:find (fn (:object row) (= row:id id))))
    (bind input (unhex spec:case:hex))
    (for-of label #a("noop" "output")
      (bind output (unhex (get (fact id label) "hex")))
      (bind ranges (cell #a())) (bind start (cell null))
      (for-of i (Array:from (obj :length (Math:max input:length output:length)) (fn (:any ignored :number i) i))
        (bind different (not (= (get input i) (get output i))))
        (if (and different (= (express start) null)) (reset! start i))
        (if (and (not different) (not (= (express start) null)))
          (do (swap! ranges append-item #a((express start) i)) (reset! start null))))
      (if (not (= (express start) null)) (swap! ranges append-item #a((express start) (Math:max input:length output:length))))
      (swap! byte-report append-item (template "\n## " id " " label "\n\nOriginal " input:length " bytes SHA256 " (await (digest input)) " hex " (hex input)
        "\n\nObserved " output:length " bytes SHA256 " (await (digest output)) " hex " (hex output)
        "\n\nDiffering ranges " (JSON:stringify (express ranges)) "\n"))))
  (bind controls (records "controls.stdout"))
  (ensure (= controls:length 3) "three supervisor controls")
  (for-of row controls
    (ensure (= row:stopReason (? (= row:id "control-timeout") "wall" (? (= row:id "control-output") "output" "rss"))) "control reason")
    (ensure (= row:exit 137) "control exit")
    (ensure (= row:survivors:length 0) "control cleanup")
    (ensure (> row:maxSampledTreeRssKiB 0) "control observation")
    (if (= row:id "control-output") (ensure (<= row:outputBytesRetained 4096) "combined output bound")))
  (bind inspected (fact "HP-inspector-control" "inspector"))
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "0") "kind") "undefined") "undefined tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "1") "kind") "null") "null tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "3") "value") "-0") "negative zero tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "4") "value") "NaN") "NaN tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "5") "value") "Infinity") "Infinity tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "6") "kind") "date") "timestamp tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "7") "hex") "00ff") "binary exact")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "8") "kind") "map") "map keys represented separately")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "9") "kind") "set") "set inspected")
  (ensure (= (get (fact "HP-inspector-control" "bounds") "truncated") true) "string bound")
  (ensure (-> (JSON:stringify (fact "HP-inspector-control" "depthBound")) (:includes "depth-bound")) "depth bound")
  (bind map-node (entry inspected "8"))
  (ensure (= (get (get (get map-node:entries 0) 0) "kind") "boolean") "map boolean key")
  (ensure (= (get (get (get map-node:entries 1) 0) "kind") "number") "map numeric key")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "6") "iso") "2026-09-12T00:00:00.000Z") "timestamp value")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "12") "kind") "function") "unsupported function tagged")
  (ensure (= (get (entry inspected "13") "length") 2) "sparse length")
  (ensure (= (get (get (entry inspected "13") "entries") "length") 0) "sparse absent own slots")
  (ensure (-> (first:get "HP-unknown-case") (get "stderr") (:includes "Unknown case ID: NOT-A-CASE")) "unknown ID explicit")
  (ensure (-> (first:get "HP-unknown-operation") (get "stderr") (:includes "Unknown operation:")) "unknown operation explicit")
  (Deno:write-text-file-sync "byte-audit.md" (template (-> (express byte-report) (:join "\n")) "\n"))
  (bind report (cell #a("# Sentinel observations" "" "Generated by retained Lykn audit; first of two deterministic attempts shown. These are preparation probes, not completed YAML families.")))
  (for-of spec specs
    (bind row (first:get spec:id))
    (swap! report append-item (template "\n## " spec:id "\n\nExit " row:exit "; stop reason " row:stopReason "; two attempts.\n"))
    (if (not (= spec:family "HP"))
      (swap! report append-item (template "\n```json\n" row:stdout "```\n"))))
  (swap! report append-item "\n## Frozen family ownership and counts\n\n| Family | Variants | Owner |\n| --- | --- | --- |")
  (for-of family (-> (Array:from families) (:sort))
    (bind owned (manifest:variants:filter (fn (:object row) (= row:family family))))
    (swap! report append-item (template "| " family " | " owned:length " | " (get (get owned 0) "owner") " |")))
  (Deno:write-text-file-sync "sentinel-summary.md" (template (-> (express report) (:join "\n")) "\n"))
  (console:log (JSON:stringify (obj :result "pass" :checks (express checks) :sentinelAttempts runs:length :frozenVariants manifest:variants:length :yamlFamilies families:size)))))
(if (= mode "graph") (graph-check))
(if (= mode "audit") (await (audit)))

(func planning-check :args (:string root) :body
  (bind scope (-> (Deno:read-text-file-sync (template root "/project07-core-library-research/arc01-format-runtime-evidence/slice03-yaml-preflight/cc-prompt.md"))
    (:split "\n") (:filter (fn (:string line) (or (line:starts-with "project07-core-library-research/") (line:starts-with "backlog/"))))))
  (bind allowed (new Set scope))
  (bind paths (-> (Deno:read-text-file-sync "changed-paths.txt") (:trim) (:split "\n")))
  (bind links (cell 0))
  (for-of path paths
    (ensure (allowed:has path) (template "outside explicit scope: " path))
    (if (path:ends-with ".md")
      (do (bind text (Deno:read-text-file-sync (template root "/" path)))
          (bind prose (text:replace (regex "```[\\s\\S]*?```" "g") ""))
          (bind base (new URL (template "file://" root "/" path)))
          (for-of match (prose:match-all (regex "\\]\\(([^\\s)]+)\\)" "g"))
            (bind target (get match 1))
            (if (not (or (target:starts-with "https:") (target:starts-with "http:") (target:starts-with "#")))
              (do (bind url (new URL target base)) (Deno:stat-sync url)
                  (swap! links (fn (:number n) (+ n 1)))))))))
  (console:log (JSON:stringify (obj :planning "pass" :paths paths:length :links (express links)))))
(if (= mode "planning") (planning-check (get Deno:args 1)))

END FILE

const encoder = new TextEncoder();
const checks = { value: 0 };
function ensure(ok, label) {
  if (typeof ok !== "boolean") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'ok' expected boolean, got " + typeof ok);

  if (typeof label !== "string") throw new TypeError("ensure: arg 'label' expected string, got " + typeof label);

  checks.value = (n => {
    if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

    return n + 1;
  })(checks.value);
  if (!ok) throw new Error(label);

}
function hex(bytes) {
  return Array.from(bytes, b => {
    if (typeof b !== "number" || Number.isNaN(b)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'b' expected number, got " + typeof b);

    return b.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
  }).join("");
}
function unhex(text) {
  if (typeof text !== "string") throw new TypeError("unhex: arg 'text' expected string, got " + typeof text);

  return Uint8Array.from(text.match(/../g) ?? [], p => {
    if (typeof p !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'p' expected string, got " + typeof p);

    return Number.parseInt(p, 16);
  });
}
async function digest(bytes) {
  return hex(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes)));
}
function appendItem(values, item) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values)) throw new TypeError("appendItem: arg 'values' expected array, got " + typeof values);

  return [...values, item];
}

function recipeBytes(recipe) {
  if (typeof recipe !== "object" || recipe === null) throw new TypeError("recipeBytes: arg 'recipe' expected object, got " + typeof recipe);

  if (recipe.kind === "depth") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("[", recipe.size)}0${String.prototype.repeat.call("]", recipe.size)}
`);

  if (recipe.kind === "string") return encoder.encode(`${String.prototype.repeat.call("x", recipe.size)}
`);

  const lines = { value: ["base: &a0 [x,x]"] };
  const level = { value: 1 };
  while (level.value <= recipe.size) {
    const n = level.value;
    lines.value = appendItem(lines.value, `a${n}: &a${n} [*a${n - 1},*a${n - 1}]`);
    level.value = (current => {
      if (typeof current !== "number" || Number.isNaN(current)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'current' expected number, got " + typeof current);

      return current + 1;
    })(level.value);
  }
  return encoder.encode(`${lines.value.join("\n")}
`);
}

function records(path) {
  if (typeof path !== "string") throw new TypeError("records: arg 'path' expected string, got " + typeof path);

  return Deno.readTextFileSync(path).trim().split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.length > 0;
  }).map(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return JSON.parse(line);
  });
}
function facts(row) {
  if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("facts: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

  return new Map(row.stdout.trim().split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.length > 0;
  }).map(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return JSON.parse(line);
  }));
}
function entry(node, key) {
  if (typeof node !== "object" || node === null) throw new TypeError("entry: arg 'node' expected object, got " + typeof node);

  if (typeof key !== "string") throw new TypeError("entry: arg 'key' expected string, got " + typeof key);

  const pair = node.entries.find(item => {
    if (!Array.isArray(item)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'item' expected array, got " + typeof item);

    const name = item[0];
    return name.value === key;
  });
  ensure(!(pair === undefined), `missing represented property ${key}`);
  return pair[1];
}
function equalFiles(a, b) {
  if (!Array.isArray(a)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'a' expected array, got " + typeof a);

  if (!Array.isArray(b)) throw new TypeError("equalFiles: arg 'b' expected array, got " + typeof b);

  return JSON.stringify(a.toSorted((x, y) => {
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  })) === JSON.stringify(b.toSorted((x, y) => {
    if (typeof x !== "object" || x === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'x' expected object, got " + typeof x);

    if (typeof y !== "object" || y === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'y' expected object, got " + typeof y);

    return x.path.localeCompare(y.path);
  }));
}
function graphCheck() {
  const graph = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("dependency-graph.json"));
  const npmKeys = Object.keys(graph.npmPackages ?? {});
  ensure(npmKeys.length === 0, "npm graph");
  for (const module of graph.modules) {
    ensure(!(module.specifier.startsWith("npm:") || module.specifier.startsWith("node:")), "Node/npm module");
    ensure(!Object.hasOwn(module, "error"), "graph resolution error");
  }
  const lock = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync("deno.lock"));
  ensure(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(lock.jsr)) === "[\"@std/yaml@1.2.0\"]", "one pinned package");
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ graph: "pass", modules: graph.modules.length, packages: Object.keys(lock.jsr) }));
}

  ensure(entry(edited, "nil")["kind"] === "null", "reread null");
  const flags = entry(edited, "flags");
  ensure(entry(flags, "0")["value"] === "true", "reread first flag");
  ensure(entry(flags, "1")["value"] === "false", "reread second flag");
  const byteReport = { value: ["# Sentinel byte audit", "", "Generated by audit.lykn; zero-based positional differing ranges [start,end), including unmatched EOF bytes. Alignment is positional, not a minimum edit script. Original/noop/edit are separate byte records."] };
  for (const id of ["Y-01-edit", "Y-10-noop", "Y-10-edit"]) {
    const spec = specs.find(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.id === id;
    });
    const input = unhex(spec.case.hex);
    for (const label of ["noop", "output"]) {
      const output = unhex(fact(id, label)["hex"]);
      const ranges = { value: [] };
      const start = { value: null };
      for (const i of Array.from({ length: Math.max(input.length, output.length) }, (ignored, i) => {
        if (typeof i !== "number" || Number.isNaN(i)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'i' expected number, got " + typeof i);

        return i;
      })) {
        const different = !(input[i] === output[i]);
        if (different && start.value === null) start.value = i;

        if (!different && !(start.value === null)) {
          ranges.value = appendItem(ranges.value, [start.value, i]);
          start.value = null;
        }
      }
      if (!(start.value === null)) ranges.value = appendItem(ranges.value, [start.value, Math.max(input.length, output.length)]);

      byteReport.value = appendItem(byteReport.value, `
## ${id} ${label}

Original ${input.length} bytes SHA256 ${await digest(input)} hex ${hex(input)}

Observed ${output.length} bytes SHA256 ${await digest(output)} hex ${hex(output)}

Differing ranges ${JSON.stringify(ranges.value)}
`);
    }
  }
  const controls = records("controls.stdout");
  ensure(controls.length === 3, "three supervisor controls");
  for (const row of controls) {
    ensure(row.stopReason === (row.id === "control-timeout" ? "wall" : row.id === "control-output" ? "output" : "rss"), "control reason");
    ensure(row.exit === 137, "control exit");
    ensure(row.survivors.length === 0, "control cleanup");
    ensure(row.maxSampledTreeRssKiB > 0, "control observation");
    if (row.id === "control-output") ensure(row.outputBytesRetained <= 4096, "combined output bound");

  }
  const inspected = fact("HP-inspector-control", "inspector");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "0")["kind"] === "undefined", "undefined tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "1")["kind"] === "null", "null tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "3")["value"] === "-0", "negative zero tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "4")["value"] === "NaN", "NaN tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "5")["value"] === "Infinity", "Infinity tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "6")["kind"] === "date", "timestamp tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "7")["hex"] === "00ff", "binary exact");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "8")["kind"] === "map", "map keys represented separately");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "9")["kind"] === "set", "set inspected");
  ensure(fact("HP-inspector-control", "bounds")["truncated"] === true, "string bound");
  ensure(JSON.stringify(fact("HP-inspector-control", "depthBound")).includes("depth-bound"), "depth bound");
  const mapNode = entry(inspected, "8");
  ensure(mapNode.entries[0][0]["kind"] === "boolean", "map boolean key");
  ensure(mapNode.entries[1][0]["kind"] === "number", "map numeric key");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "6")["iso"] === "2026-09-12T00:00:00.000Z", "timestamp value");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "12")["kind"] === "function", "unsupported function tagged");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "13")["length"] === 2, "sparse length");
  ensure(entry(inspected, "13")["entries"]["length"] === 0, "sparse absent own slots");
  ensure(first.get("HP-unknown-case")["stderr"].includes("Unknown case ID: NOT-A-CASE"), "unknown ID explicit");
  ensure(first.get("HP-unknown-operation")["stderr"].includes("Unknown operation:"), "unknown operation explicit");
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("byte-audit.md", `${byteReport.value.join("\n")}
`);
  const report = { value: ["# Sentinel observations", "", "Generated by retained Lykn audit; first of two deterministic attempts shown. These are preparation probes, not completed YAML families."] };
  for (const spec of specs) {
    const row = first.get(spec.id);
    report.value = appendItem(report.value, `
## ${spec.id}

Exit ${row.exit}; stop reason ${row.stopReason}; two attempts.
`);
    if (!(spec.family === "HP")) report.value = appendItem(report.value, `
\`\`\`json
${row.stdout}\`\`\`
`);

  }
  report.value = appendItem(report.value, "\n## Frozen family ownership and counts\n\n| Family | Variants | Owner |\n| --- | --- | --- |");
  for (const family of Array.from(families).sort()) {
    const owned = manifest.variants.filter(row => {
      if (typeof row !== "object" || row === null) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'row' expected object, got " + typeof row);

      return row.family === family;
    });
    report.value = appendItem(report.value, `| ${family} | ${owned.length} | ${owned[0]["owner"]} |`);
  }
  Deno.writeTextFileSync("sentinel-summary.md", `${report.value.join("\n")}
`);
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ result: "pass", checks: checks.value, sentinelAttempts: runs.length, frozenVariants: manifest.variants.length, yamlFamilies: families.size }));
}

function planningCheck(root) {
  if (typeof root !== "string") throw new TypeError("planningCheck: arg 'root' expected string, got " + typeof root);

  const scope = Deno.readTextFileSync(`${root}/project07-core-library-research/arc01-format-runtime-evidence/slice03-yaml-preflight/cc-prompt.md`).split("\n").filter(line => {
    if (typeof line !== "string") throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'line' expected string, got " + typeof line);

    return line.startsWith("project07-core-library-research/") || line.startsWith("backlog/");
  });
  const allowed = new Set(scope);
  const paths = Deno.readTextFileSync("changed-paths.txt").trim().split("\n");
  const links = { value: 0 };
  for (const path of paths) {
    ensure(allowed.has(path), `outside explicit scope: ${path}`);
    if (path.endsWith(".md")) {
      const text = Deno.readTextFileSync(`${root}/${path}`);
      const prose = text.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, "");
      const base = new URL(`file://${root}/${path}`);
      for (const match of prose.matchAll(/\]\(([^\s)]+)\)/g)) {
        const target = match[1];
        if (!((target.startsWith("https:") || target.startsWith("http:")) || target.startsWith("#"))) {
          const url = new URL(target, base);
          Deno.statSync(url);
          links.value = (n => {
            if (typeof n !== "number" || Number.isNaN(n)) throw new TypeError("anonymous: arg 'n' expected number, got " + typeof n);

            return n + 1;
          })(links.value);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return console.log(JSON.stringify({ planning: "pass", paths: paths.length, links: links.value }));
}
if (mode === "planning") planningCheck(Deno.args[1]);
